name: 8 Ball
text: Compared to other Tarot-generating jokers, 8 Ball is slow to begin with. You would need to draw and play all four 8s in your deck to simply match the expected value of a Cartomancer, and even then, it's not unlikely that you'll whiff every trigger and end up with no Tarots for your effort. However, if you're patient enough to play towards it, you'll find it's one of the most effective Tarot generators in the game. Unlike other Jokers of its kind, an 8 Ball at maximum efficiency can create multiple Tarots per hand without copy effects, outpacing even a Vagabond.

name: 8 Ball
text: The deck-fixing properties that Tarot cards provide can make it easier to play more 8s and thus recursively create more Tarots. The enhancements can help with scoring as well, making up for the rank's relative lack of scoring Jokers. All of this is especially effective if the player is able to get a Red Seal on one of their 8s and then repeatedly copy it.

Strategies that involve winning the round with one high-scoring hand like Four of a Kind or Straight Flush can take advantage of this Joker by playing throwaway hands until the Acrobat is activated. Used like this, the Acrobat is virtually a X3 Mult on the entire round score. Conversely, a strategy revolving around playing multiple easy to make hands does not benefit as much.

name: Baron
text: On first glance, Baron might seem like a small amount of Mult. However, what makes Baron so incredibly strong is that every King or Steel card in hand multiplies your score exponentially. For example, one King only multiplies your score by 1.5x. But two Kings multiplies it by 1.5x twice, which is a 2.25x increase. If an ideal card for Baron is held in hand (a steel King with a red seal), it will produce x1.5⁴ = ~x5.1 Mult. With Mime, this increases to x1.5⁶ = ~x11.4 Mult; with one Blueprint/Brainstorm copying Mime, it increases to x1.5⁸ = ~x25.6 Mult, and with two cards copying each Mime and Baron it rises further to x1.5¹² = ~x130 Mult.

name: Baron
text: If a player manages to find these four Jokers and enough steel Kings with red seals to fill a hand, they will be able to play far into Endless mode. For example, with a Hand size of eight, the base Mult would be multiplied by ~x619 trillion; with a Hand size of nine this increases to ~80 quadrillion; and with a Hand size of ten it further increases to ~10 quintillion (1.0x10¹⁹). With some base chips and mult, this is enough to finish the first 16 Antes. Using this strategy, players can achieve the elusive Naneinf score, most often on Plasma Deck due to its score balancing mechanic lowering the amount of cards necessary, or on Ghost Deck due to easier access to Spectral cards such as Deja Vu to apply a Red Seal and Cryptid to copy cards, as well as temporarily bypass the hand size limit.

text: Copying a Joker that earns $money or creates cards (especially Tarot) is a great option when boosting score is not necessary.

name: Blueprint
text: When copying chance-based Jokers like Space Joker, the chance is rolled

name: Blueprint
text: On a Knife's Edge Deck starts with a copy of Ceremonial Dagger pinned in the leftmost position, which means it can't be copied by Blueprint (unless it's copying Brainstorm), limiting it's usage.

name: Blueprint
text: Amber Acorn: This boss blind flips and shuffles Jokers around, which can make Blueprint copy the incorrect Joker, or copy nothing at all if it happens to be moved to the rightmost position or to the left of an incompatible Joker, for at least one hand.

name: Blueprint
text: If the player presses "Play Hand", then quickly attempts to move Blueprint to a different position in the joker panel while the hand is scoring, the Blueprint will copy the effect of the joker that it was to the left of before the hand is played. For example, if a player has three jokers, positioned in this way before playing this hand: Blueprint, Greedy Joker, and Fibonacci, then attempted to move the Blueprint to the right of Greedy Joker and to the left of Fibonacci immediately after the "Play Hand" button is triggered, the Blueprint will trigger the effect of Greedy Joker instead of Fibonacci.

name: Blueprint
text: However, the copy order changes once the round is complete. For example, if the player moves your Blueprint to copy Mime while your winning hand is scoring, then the player will receive the benefits of multiple copies of Mime during the end-of-round effects (such as Golds or Blue Seal). Players should move all of their copies of Blueprint and Brainstorm onto Mime while their final hand is scoring for maximum Gold card and Blue Seal value.

name: Bootstraps
text: Yellow Deck's starting Money bonus makes it easier to build up money quickly.

name: Bootstraps
text: Rich get Richer Deck also encourages the player to have a lot of money, similar to Bootstraps.

name: Bootstraps
text: Blast Off Deck starts with an Eternal Rocket, which allows Bootstraps to get a lot of value pretty quickly.

name: Bootstraps
text: Any hand can benefit from Bootstraps.

name: Bootstraps
text: Bull similarly provides a Chips boost for having Money.

name: Bootstraps
text: Investment Tag, Handy Tag, Garbage Tag, Economy Tag, Speed Tag all give money if the player is willing to skip blinds for them. Investment and Economy though are the best ones for Bootstraps, as Investment will add a hefty +10 Mult to Bootstraps's Mult value once the Boss blind is defeated, and Economy can grant up $40.

name: Bootstraps
text: While Bootstrap's unlock condition may appear difficult to achieve, under the right circumstances it can be surprisingly easy.

name: Bootstraps
text: Ghost Deck starts the player with a Hex, allowing any of the run's first purchased Jokers to become Polychrome.

name: Bootstraps
text: In addition to this, Hex cannot destroy Eternal Jokers, making the requirement even easier on Black Stake and above.

name: Bootstraps
text: As long as the player uses the given Hex on an Eternal Joker, the unlock can be achieved by finding a second Hex in the shop due to Ghost Deck's innate ability.

name: Bootstraps
text: Alternatively, the player can use Ankh or Invisible Joker to duplicate the Polychrome Joker to unlock the requirement.

name: Brainstorm
text: Due to the difference in the way it copies a card, and the nature of Jokers triggering left to right, Brainstorm will always be in Blueprint's shadow — by a small amount. Brainstorm's disadvantage is that xMult Jokers (such as Cavendish) must be placed all the way to the left to be copied by Brainstorm, meaning the player cannot multiply the Mult from +Mult Jokers such as Supernova twice. For example, Supernova + Blueprint + The Trio will score more than The Trio + Supernova + Brainstorm. However, a Polychrome Brainstorm can copy a +Mult Joker to its left while still allowing the full benefit of its edition effect. Some notable targets for copying include Jokers that make money mid-Blind such as Mail-In Rebate, retrigger Jokers such as Dusk, and xMult Jokers that trigger before most +Mult jokers anyways, such as Baron, Photograph or Bloodstone. When multiple copies are combined with Baron and Mime, usually while using Plasma Deck, players can achieve the elusive Naneinf score.

name: Brainstorm
text: When copying a Blueprint, Brainstorm will copy whichever effect Blueprint is copying, not the Blueprint itself.

name: Brainstorm
text: While it will not work with them, Jokers such as Smeared Joker and Four Fingers can be used to unlock Brainstorm more easily.

name: Brainstorm
text: See the Blueprint page for more general copying strategies.

name: Brainstorm
text: On a Knife's Edge Deck starts with a copy of Ceremonial Dagger pinned to the leftmost position, which means Brainstorm can only copy that Joker, limiting its usage.

name: Brainstorm
text: Amber Acorn: This Showdown Blind flips and shuffles Jokers around, potentially causing Brainstorm to copy the incorrect Joker, or copy nothing at all if it happens to be moved to the leftmost position or the leftmost Joker is incompatible for at least one hand.

name: Brainstorm

text: If the player presses "Play Hand", then quickly attempts to change the leftmost Joker while the hand is scoring, then Brainstorm will copy the effect of the leftmost Joker before the hand is played. For example, if a player has three Jokers, positioned in this way before playing this hand: Lusty Joker, Smiley Face, and Brainstorm, then attempting to move the Smiley Face to the leftmost position immediately after the "Play Hand" button is pressed, the Brainstorm will copy the effect of Lusty Joker instead of Smiley Face.

name: Brainstorm
text: However, the copy order changes once the round is complete. For example, if the player moves Mime to the leftmost position while the player's winning hand is scoring, then the player will receive the benefits of multiple copies of Mime during the end-of-round effects (such as Golds or Blue Seal). Players should move all of their copies of Blueprint and Brainstorm onto Mime while their final hand is scoring for maximum Gold card or Blue Seal value.

name: Brainstorm
text: Unlocking Brainstorm can be done easily on either Red Deck, Checkered Deck, or Painted Deck by simply starting a run below Blue Stake and intentionally expending Hands as Discards before drawing a Royal Flush to discard.

name: Bull
text: Yellow Deck starts the player off with $14, giving Bull a boost not granted by any other Deck.

name: Bull
text: Plasma Deck focuses more on Chips than Mult, meaning that Bull can become a strong Joker even into the late-game assuming the player doesn't spend too much money.

name: Bull
text: Blast Off Deck starts with an Eternal Rocket, which allows Bull to get a lot of value pretty quickly.

name: Bull
text: Bull's bonus chips work well with any Hand, but it might be easier to start with high Mult Hands such as Full House.

name: Bull
text: Bootstraps similarly provides a Mult boost for having money.

name: Bull
text: All Economy Jokers, like Rocket or Golden Ticket help accumulate money quickly.

name: Bull
text: Midas Mask, while not directly being an Economy Joker, can create Gold cards which can then earn money.

name: Bull
text: Golds give $3 at the end of the round, and can be doubled when combined with Mime.

name: Bull
text: Luckys have a 1 in 15 chance to give $20. Retrigger Jokers or Oops! All 6s are recommended.

name: Bull
text: Gold Seal gives $3 when triggered, which is especially useful when combined with retrigger Jokers like Hanging Chad.

name: Bull
text: The Hermit can give up to $20.

name: Bull
text: In Rich get Richer Deck, Bull gives fewer chips than usual due to the cap on Chips, although it does always ensure Chips are maximised.

name: Bull
text: Green Deck has poor synergy because it encourages the player to spend money as they earn it.

name: Bull
text: Luxury Tax Deck encourages the player to not have too much money, which can make it harder to use Bull effectively.

name: Bull
text: The Omelette Deck, while not being a direct counter, makes it very hard to get money, making Bull weaker.

name: Bull
text: Vagabond will never generate any Tarot cards if the player has a lot of money.

name: Bull
text: Credit Card is useless as going into debt makes Bull do nothing.

name: Bull
text: The Ox can neutralize Bull if the most played hand is played, resetting money to $0.

name: Burglar
text: Green Deck: As leftover hands and discards act as a pseudo-Interest, Burglar essentially trades $1 from each removed discard for $2 for each of the 3 extra hands.

name: Burglar
text: Black Deck: Burglar mitigates the -1 Hand downside while also adding 2 extra hands, but removes all discards.

name: Burglar
text: Burglar's extra hands make use of poker hands that can be played at a high frequency, such as High Card, Pair, or Two Pair. On a deck that concentrates on one specific rank, this can also be Three of a Kind, Five of a Kind, or Flush Five.

name: Burglar
text: Ride the Bus, Green Joker, Square Joker, Spare Trousers, or Supernova all scale from playing hands, which is made way easier thanks to Burglar.

name: Burglar
text: Burglar removing all discards allows Mystic Summit to always trigger its +15 Mult effect.

name: Burglar
text: Burglar, unlike its discard counterpart Merry Andy, can be copied by Blueprint/Brainstorm for an extra 3 hands each copy. This effect also poses no downside because of how the copying effects can be used on another Joker afterwards without any consequences.

name: Burglar
text: Additionally, because of how Burglar triggers when blind is selected, the player can abuse this by setting the game speed down and swapping Burglar with other Jokers that also trigger at the start of round, such as Marble Joker or Certificate for Blueprint/Brainstorm to copy after Bu

name: Burglar
text: Red Deck and Five-Card Draw Deck: The extra discards provided by them are negated when a blind is selected.

name: Burglar
text: Any Joker that triggers off of discards like Banner and Delayed Gratification will have no effect.

name: Burglar
text: Jokers that need cards to be discarded to scale, like Yorick and Castle, can no longer scale.

name: Burglar
text: Jokers that give extra discards like Drunkard and Merry Andy will have no effect.

name: Burglar
text: The Merry Andy, in particular, with the Burglar, will only decrease hand size by 1.

name: Burglar
text: Jokers that activate on discard, like Mail-In Rebate, Trading Card, and Burnt Joker, can no longer function.

name: Burglar
text: Jokers that decrease in value when playing hands like Seltzer and Ice Cream will likely be used up faster.

name: Burglar
text: Jokers that activate on the final hand, such as Acrobat and Dusk. Given that Burglar provides more

name: Burglar
text: Burglar allows Jokers that scale off of played hands to scale much faster, such as Ride the Bus, Green Joker, Square Joker, Spare Trousers, or Supernova.

name: Burglar
text: Burglar lets the player generate much more resources with Jokers that generate value off of played hands, such as Reserved Parking, Space Joker, or Vagabond.

name: Burglar
text: A build capable of scoring the elusive Naneinf score typically consists of playing on the Plasma Deck while on the Boss Blind The Serpent, after copying Burglar with Blueprint and Brainstorm, and holding both Baron and Mime.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Red Deck - The +1 discard makes the Burnt Joker have less of a downside.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Checkered Deck - Only having two suits makes it significantly more likely to have a Flush in hand at all times.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Abandoned Deck - The lack of face cards makes it easier to find certain hands for Burnt Joker to discard without using a lot of hands.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Simple hands such as Pairs or High Cards are more likely to naturally occur, thus making them easier to discard and level up.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Blueprint or Brainstorm - Synergizes incredibly well, as after the desired hand is discarded it can be moved to copy a different Joker before a hand is played.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Drunkard and Merry Andy increase the number of Discards, making the first Discard for Burnt Joker inconsequential.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Jokers that make a particular hand easier to produce, such as Four Fingers, Shortcut, and Smeared Joker, can make it easier to discard their related hands, especially if you then want to be able to play the same hand immediately afterwards; Four Fingers and Shortcut also allow you to hit the relevant hand when discarding fewer cards, for situations when there are cards in your hand you want to keep.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Wasteful and Recyclomancy both increase discards, making the first discards for Burnt Joker inconsequential.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Painted Deck starts with -1 Joker Slot, which makes it harder to carry Burnt Joker alongside other scoring Jokers, though its bigger hand size makes it easier to find the hand to discard.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Similarly, Cruelty Deck is even more difficult to carry Burnt Joker alongside other scoring Jokers due to the -2 Joker Slots.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Blast Off Deck not only starts with one less Joker Slot, but also starts with 2 discards, making Burnt Joker more committal to utilize.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Five-card hands that are hard to draw naturally like Straight, Full House, Straight Flush can make it hard to benefit from Burnt Joker.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Jokers that discourage Discarding such as Green Joker, Delayed Gratification or Ramen can make it harder to benefit from Burnt Joker.

name: Burnt Joker
text: Burglar removes all Discards, nullifying Burnt Joker.

name: Burnt Joker
text: May or may not have anti-synergy wit

name: Burnt Joker
text: Burnt Joker can be triggered as normal by debuffed cards.

name: Burnt Joker
text: The Hook's forced discards will not activate Burnt Joker.

name: Business Card
text: Business Card wants you to play many face cards all at once. Therefore, the best hands you could play with this are ones that have the most face cards in them (preferably 5). Full House is the easiest to access early on and can be fairly consistent. Later on in the game, Four of a Kind or Five of a Kind hands can give just as much of a chance for money but can often score higher as long as your Full House isn't upgraded as much. Later in the game you can also access Flush House and Flush Five for an even bigger increase in score.

name: Business Card
text: Pareidolia enables Business Card to pay out on any played card.

name: Business Card
text: Oops! All 6s guarantees payout from Business Card.

name: Business Card
text: Retrigger jokers that affect face cards, such as Sock and Buskin or Seltzer, allow Business Card to pay out more than once.

name: Business Card
text: Splash allows Business Card to affect all face cards played by making them all score.

name: Business Card
text: Midas Mask's ability turns all face cards gold, resulting in more income.

name: Business Card
text: Other jokers that increase the scoring of played face cards (e.g. Scary Face for + Chips, Smiley Face for + Mult, and Triboulet for X Mult) provide additional benefit when face cards are played.

name: Business Card
text: Reserved Parking provides income on unplayed face cards, so having both this Joker and Business Card in a face card focused deck can provide a steady stream of money.

name: Business Card
text: Abandoned Deck and Medusa Deck start with no face cards, making Business Card pretty much useless unless the player has Pareidolia.

name: Business Card
text: Ride the Bus requires face cards to not be played in order to grow its Mult bonus.

name: Business Card
text: Canio's ability activates only upon destroying face cards, resulting in fewer cards able to trigger Business Card.

name: Business Card
text: The Mark draws all face cards face down, making it more difficult to assemble a good hand for Business Card.

name: Business Card
text: The Plant debuffs all face cards, rendering Business Card useless for the round.

name: Business Card
text: The Mad World Deck challenge starts the player with an Eternal copy of Business Card.

name: Campfire
text: Zodiac Deck starts you with the Tarot Merchant and Planet Merchant Vouchers, which make consumable cards appear more often, and the Overstock Voucher, which makes more cards appear in the shop. This combines to provide a vast amount of cards you can sell every shop.

name: Campfire
text: Yellow Deck lets you build money much faster, which is needed to scale Campfire.

name: Campfire
text: Black Deck's extra Joker slot lets you have five Jokers while still having room to buy and sell with the final slot.

name: Campfire
text: Since Campfire provides a strong X Mult bonus, any Poker Hand with a high base Mult like Flush, Straight, Full House, will benefit greatly.

name: Campfire
text: The cornerstone of Campfire's functioning is economy. It is best paired with at least one money-generating Joker, the more powerful the better. It doesn't necessarily need this, though, if it is added late-game when you already have a large amount of money.

name: Campfire
text: Jokers that generate other cards, like Cartomancer, Riff-Raff and Perkeo, can then have those cards be sold for extra scaling.

name: Campfire
text: A strong source of + Mult is near required to make Campfire work. The single best Joker for this is Flash Card, as you will want to be rerolling anyway to find more cards to sell, but other strong options include Onyx Agate and Spare Trousers.

name: Campfire
text: Astronomer allows you to buy planet cards for free and sell them for a profit, which allows for more buying and selling of other cards.

name: Campfire
text: Painted Deck's -1 Joker Slot and Nebula Deck's -1 Consumable Slot can make it harder to have a room for Jokers to sell and hold onto Consumables to sell, respectively, to increase its effectiveness between antes.

name: Campfire
text: This also applies to Blast Off Deck and Cruelty Deck.

name: Campfire
text: Ghost Deck allows for Spectral cards to appear in the shop, but they're more expensive than Tarots or Planets, and selling them is not always something the player would want to do.

name: Campfire
text: Fortune Teller and Constellation encourage the player to use Tarot cards and Planet cards, respectively, which is the opposite of what Campfire does.

name: Campfire
text: Throwback and Diet Cola rely on skipping blinds, which results in Campfire being reset faster.

name: Canio
text: Canio gives multiplicative Mult to all hands once at least 1 face card is destroyed. Because of its run-winning potency, the player should try to build into Canio whenever possible. However, with builds relying on face cards, destroying them for Canio might drastically affect the run's safety. Balancing destroying face cards for Canio and not succumbing to the temptation of scaling it is the key to winning a run with Canio.

name: Canio
text: Most decks can benefit greatly from Canio, as they all have face cards. Although, it is noteworthy that some decks grant easier access to Tarot cards, which includes The Hanged Man, making it an important factor to consider when the goal of the run is obtaining and maximizing Canio.

name: Canio
text: The Ghost Deck grants easier access to the otherwise hard to find Spectral cards via The Shop, in which 4 of them can help Canio scale by destroying playing cards, those being Familiar, Grim, Incantation, and Immolate.

name: Canio
text: 15 Minute City Deck starts with 24 face cards, allowing this Joker to scale easier.

name: Canio
text: Mad World Deck starts with an Eternal Pareidolia, which allows this Joker to scale easier, but be wary not to destroy too many cards due to the small size of this deck.

name: Canio
text: Because of how Canio provides a strong source of multiplicative Mult, poker hands that have a higher base Mult and scaling te

name: Canio
text: Abandoned Deck and Medusa Deck are not recommended due to their default lack of face cards, making it significantly harder to scale Canio.

name: Canio
text: Jokers that synergize with face cards, such as Baron, Sock and Buskin, and Triboulet, do not work well with Canio because you're destroying many face cards, which will hurt the collective output.

name: Canio
text: The Plant makes it so that all face cards are debuffed, and face cards destroyed during this Boss blind will not scale Canio.

name: Card Sharp
text: Checkered Deck: Start run with 26 Spades and 26 Hearts, making repeated flushes easier.

name: Card Sharp
text: Blue Deck: +1 hand per round, allowing more chances to play repeated hands.

name: Card Sharp
text: Red Deck: +1 discard, allowing more chance to assemble desired hands.

name: Card Sharp
text: Strong 5-card hands like Flush, Straight, Full House, etc... benefit the most from Card Sharp, provided they can be played at least twice per blind.

name: Card Sharp
text: Players may opt to buff weaker hands like High Card, Pair, Two Pair, etc... with Planet cards to make their base Mult stronger, allowing repeated play for each blind to score larger.

name: Card Sharp
text: Burglar: +3 hands, allowing more chances to play repeated hands.

name: Card Sharp
text: Wasteful and Recyclomancy both give additional discards, allowing the player more opportunities to assemble the desired hand.

name: Card Sharp
text: Black Deck starts with one less hand, which makes it harder to work around Card Sharp.

name: Card Sharp
text: Similarly, Blast Off Deck starts with two less hands, which makes it even harder to work around Card Sharp.

name: Card Sharp
text: Golden Needle Deck only starts with one hand, rendering Card Sharp useless.

name: Card Sharp

name: Card Sharp
text: Hieroglyph is not recommended as the -1 hand each round which means less chances to play the same hand.

name: Card Sharp
text: The Needle: This boss hard counters Card Sharp as it only allows 1 hand to be played. Burglar is an effective safety against this, as discards are converted after the blind effect is applied.

text: Card Sharp only applies to the scoring hand, not the hands that it contains. For example, playing a Straight Flush after a Flush or Straight does not give X3 Mult.

name: Card Sharp
text: The Five-Card Draw Deck challenge starts the player with a copy of Card Sharp.

name: Cartomancer
text: Black Deck: Its inherent +1 Joker slot allows Cartomancer to be used alongside 5 other scoring Jokers. Moreover, acquiring The Hermit or Temperance early from this Joker's effect can help this Deck reach its ceiling sooner by overstepping its largest weakness: its poor early-game economy.

name: Cartomancer
text: Magic Deck: This 52-stack of wizardry starts the player with the Crystal Ball Voucher, giving an extra consumable slot to hold more Tarot cards. This serves several functions when combined with this Joker: scoring-oriented Tarot cards like Justice can be stored to save a run in a pinch; the starting copies of The Fool will have easier access to more desirable targets, and potentially unwanted Tarot cards can be stored to prevent them from reappearing elsewhere. Obtaining earlier access to the Omen Globe Voucher can be of potential interest, too - by allowing Spectral cards to appear in Arcana Packs, they can be viewed as potential mini-Spectral Packs, as there would already be a reliable source of Tarot cards.

name: Cartomancer
text: Cartomancer does not synergize directly with any poker hand. It provides very slight favor to the 5-card hands, however, as they provide more opportunities for Enhancements (applied by Tarot cards) to pump up the score.

name: Cartomancer
text: The following Jokers have synergy with Cartomancer:

name: Cartomancer
text: Fortune Teller: Perhaps the strongest synergy that either of these two have, it will

name: Cartomancer
text: Nebula Deck's -1 consumable slot can make it harder to hold and use Tarot cards from Cartomancer.

name: Cartomancer
text: Anaglyph Deck: With emphasis placed on skipping Blinds for duplication of powerful Tags, it has slight anti-synergy with this Joker. It can still be very useful early on, however, especially in the absence of particularly strong Tags.

name: Cartomancer
text: Throwback: A Joker that encourages skipping Blinds. Cartomancer will have fewer opportunities to create Tarot cards if scaling Throwback is more of a priority.

name: Castle
text: The Checkered Deck works well with Castle due to the lower suit diversity.

name: Castle

name: Castle

name: Castle

name: Castle
text: The Erratic Deck can start with a lot of cards of a certain suit, making it easier to fix the deck for Castle.

name: Castle
text: Because Castle scales based on discarding cards, it means that weaker, easier hands like High Card and Pair allow for the effect to be used more consistently.

name: Castle
text: Alternately, when players manage to shape their deck down to a single suit, Flush-based hands like Flush, Straight Flush, Flush House, and Flush Five become much more viable.

name: Castle
text: Drunkard and Merry Andy both provide additional discards, allowing Castle to scale more per round.

name: Castle
text: Yorick will also scale alongside Castle.

name: Castle
text: Smeared Joker makes Castle twice as easy to scale.

name: Castle
text: Paint Brush and Palette increase the player's hand size, allowing players to see more of their deck and give them more chances to discard cards chosen by Castle.

name: Castle
text: Wasteful and Recyclomancy both give 1 extra discard, allowing Castle to scale faster.

name: Castle

name: Cavendish
text: This Joker works well with any of the Decks, as it gives X3 Mult to every hand played.

name: Cavendish
text: Any hand can benefit from this Joker for the same reasons that any of the Decks can.

name: Cavendish
text: Cavendish, as any Multplicative Mult Joker, pairs incredibly well with Additive Mult Jokers and other Multiplicative Mult Jokers, especially scaling ones. This includes Jokers such as Green Joker, Fortune Teller and Flash Card.

name: Cavendish
text: Copying Cavendish with Blueprint and Brainstorm does not increase the probability of self-destruction of Cavendish or cause the copying Joker to self-destruct, so they can be used without additional risks.

name: Cavendish
text: Oops! All 6s doubles Cavendish's destruction chance to a 2 in 1000 chance. This can safely be ignored in most cases.

name: Cavendish
text: To guarantee that Cavendish gets destroyed, the player would need 10 copies of Oops! All 6s (which would display as a 1024 in 1000 chance).

name: Cavendish
text: The Non-Perishable Deck challenge bans Cavendish.

name: Cavendish
text: While Cavendish can also go "Extinct!", it is still able to show up in the shop again, unlike Gros Michel.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Yellow Deck is a good option, as the early bonus money allows players to get to $25 quickly and be able to save up a lot for the Dagger.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Black Deck's extra Joker slot is very helpful, as one can still have four safe Jokers while scaling Dagger.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Similarly,Five-Card Draw Deck's 2 extra Jokers slots is even better, as one can still have six Jokers while scaling Dagger.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Anaglyph Deck is occasionally a good choice, as the Double Tag can provide lots of economic buffs when presented. However, skipping a blind means skipping a level of scaling.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Inflation Deck might work with Ceremonial Dagger, as this deck permanently increases prices by $1 on every purchase, including the sell price. This Joker can scale very fast thanks to Jokers' inflated sell prices.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: This Joker can sometimes make it more difficult to change your deck due to needing a constant supply of money to fuel its destruction of other Jokers. As a result, it might be best to prioritize easier-to-play hands. However, the hand you play doesn't really matter, as the Mult Dagger provides will always apply.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Ceremonial Dagger is, at its core, an economy-based scaling Joker. Therefore, having more money makes it better, as one can afford more expensive Jokers to scale it. There are many options, but it's recommended to go for more powerful ones, like Cloud 9 or Golden Ticket, as Joker slots are limited with Dagger.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Painted Deck's reduced Joker amount is bad to combo with Ceremonial Dagger, as the player will only have three Jokers while scaling Ceremonial Dagger.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Similarly, Cruelty Deck's reduced Joker amount is even more difficult to combo with Ceremonial Dagger, as the player will only have two Jokers while scaling Ceremonial Dagger.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Non-Perishable Deck does not work with Ceremonial Dagger, as all Jokers are Eternal, and it cannot destroy them and doesn't gain + Mult.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Abstract Joker depends on having many Jokers to boost its +Mult, which it can't do very well with Ceremonial Dagger destroying Jokers left and to the right, which reduces the total Joker count.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Throwback depends on skipping Blinds, and when a Blind is skipped, Ceremonial Dagger cannot be upgraded.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Clearance Sale a

name: Ceremonial Dagger
text: Ceremonial Dagger has high growth potential, while this requires an additional Joker Slot (used to place the Joker to be destroyed) to achieve. However, outside of the On a Knife's Edge Deck Challenge, Ceremonial Dagger can be used alongside other Jokers once it's buffed up significantly. Simply move it to the rightmost slot at the end of each blind, start a new blind, and move it back to the leftmost side so it can provide maximum effect for other Multiplicative Jokers. This ensures Ceremonial Dagger doesn't consume any other Jokers while still providing +Mult for the round. On Black Stake difficulty or higher (and in some Challenges), it is also possible to put an Eternal Joker to the right of it and prevent Ceremonial Dagger from destroying Jokers.

name: Certificate
text: Because Magic Deck starts with Crystal Ball, it allows the player to make better use of Blue Seals and Purple Seals.

name: Certificate
text: Painted Deck's extra hand size allows the player to hold more cards created by Certificate, as well as finding a desired hand whilst holding onto those cards more easily.

name: Certificate
text: Zodiac Deck can use its extra Tarot cards to more easily manipulate the Sealed cards from Certificate.

name: Certificate
text: Abandoned Deck's and Mad World Deck's reduced deck size make it easier to find the produced cards after they have been added to the deck. It is also easier to flood these decks with high-quality cards, since there are fewer bad cards to potentially draw.

name: Certificate
text: No specific poker hand directly benefits from Certificate, but any of them can be leveled up with its generated Blue Seals. Hands that benefit more from planet cards therefore indirectly benefit more.

name: Certificate
text: If Certificate is held for only a couple of rounds, the generated cards are generally high-value duplication targets, and it can be easier to make powerful Five of a Kinds or Flush Fives.

name: Certificate
text: If Certificate is held for a long time or is Eternal, then lower value poker hands like High Card and Pair that do not rely on finding specific cards can be easier to find with many extra random cards in the deck.

name: Certificate
text: Hologram scales with each card Certificate adds.

name: Certificate
text: DNA is better when copying valuab

name: Certificate
text: Nebula Deck makes it significantly harder to use Blue and Purple Seals due to the starting 1 consumable slot.

name: Certificate
text: On Checkered Deck Certificate can still create Clubs and Diamonds cards, which can make it harder to play flushes.

name: Certificate
text: If Certificate is held for a long time or is Eternal, then higher value poker hands like Straight and Four of a Kind that rely on finding specific cards can be much harder to find with many extra random cards in the deck.

name: Certificate
text: Erosion relies on a small deck size, which is more difficult to get when 1 card is added per round from Certificate.

name: Certificate
text: Blue Seal#Anti-Synergies

name: Certificate
text: Cards that decrease the players hand size, like Stuntman and Ouija can make finding and holding Blue seals more difficult.

name: Certificate
text: When Certificate adds a sealed card at the beginning of the round, it is put directly into your hand, bypassing the normal hand size temporarily.

name: Certificate
text: Certificate does not prevent the player from dying when they have a hand size of zero or below, since the game checks the hand size before Certificate can activate.

name: Certificate
text: Unlike other Jokers that activated "When a blind is selected", Certificate activates "when a round begins", which is when the initial hand is drawn. This means Blueprint / Brainstorm can be used to copy for example Cartomancer, then immediately moved over to copy Certificate after clicking Select Blind (best done at lower game speeds).

name: Certificate
text: The Fragile Deck challenge bans Certificate.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: Zodiac Deck works well with this Joker, as you will want to be rerolling more to see more Tarot and Planet cards.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: Black Deck is decent for this Joker, as rerolling a lot allows you to see more Jokers that you can take.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: Flash Card: use the free reroll to boost this after every shop visit.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: Campfire: can scale quicker, as the free reroll can let you find more Jokers or Consumables to buy and sell.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: Constellation: can scale very quickly, as the free reroll can let you find more planet cards each shop.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: Astronomer: can let you find more free planet cards.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: Overstock and Overstock Plus can make Chaos's free reroll much more significant.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: Reroll Surplus and Reroll Glut combined with Chaos is practically equivalent to a D6 Tag.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: On Gold Stake, Chaos the Clown can be Rental, allowing the player to purchase it for $1, get a free re-roll, and then sell it back again for $1 to remain money neutral.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: The next reroll still starts at the same price it would have been without the extra reroll, so Chaos the Clown effectively saves $ equal to \text{Rerolls} + 4.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: With Reroll Surplus, this becomes \text{Savings} = \text{Rerolls} + 2, and with Reroll Glut, it becomes \text{Savings} = \text{Rerolls}.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: If Chaos the Clown is obtained while in a shop, the price for the current shop reroll will be brought down to $0, regardless of whether it is the first reroll in that shop or not. The next reroll will cost where it previously left off.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: If the player sells Chaos the Clown whilst the once-per-shop free reroll is active, the reroll cost will immediately revert to the regular value.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: As Chaos the Clown costs $4 but a standard re-roll costs $5, it can be cheaper to buy him to reroll the shop, and the player can sell him again later for an extra $2 back.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: If Chaos the Clown is sold after using its one free reroll and another one is found, it can be purchased again for another free reroll.

name: Chaos the Clown
text: Multiple copies of Chaos the Clown (obtained through Ankh, Invisible Joker, or Showman) do stack, allowing the player to get 2 free rerolls. However, it cannot be copied Blueprint or Brainstorm.

name: Chicot
text: Black Deck has +1 Joker slot, which leaves more room for scoring Jokers.

name: Chicot
text: Boss Blinds can affect almost every Joker in the game, and thus be helped by Chicot, but many Jokers have notable weaknesses to particular Boss Blinds. Chicot can negate the holes in these Jokers' defenses:

name: Chicot
text: Photograph, Smiley Face, and other face card Jokers no longer fear The Plant or The Mark.

name: Chicot
text: In this context, Pareidolia becomes less punishing to use.

name: Chicot
text: Bloodstone, Seeing Double, and other Card Suit Jokers can ignore their respective Boss Blinds.

name: Chicot
text: In particular, Flower Pot and Ancient Joker can safely rely on Wild cards with Chicot.

name: Chicot
text: Card Sharp, Supernova, and other Jokers limited by poker hand-limiting Boss Blinds.

name: Chicot
text: Burglar is no longer weak against The Mouth or The Fish.

name: Chicot
text: Any Oops! All 6s based run will no longer fear The Wheel.

name: Chicot
text: Jokers that rely on discards (by either keeping them or using them), such as Banner or Castle, can safely ignore The Water.

name: Chicot
text: Disabling a boss blind reverses its effect, and due to the timing involved, multiple copies of Chicot will all disable the Boss Blind, resulting in a net positive effect:

name: Chicot
text: The Wall: Score requirement is reduced by a factor of 2 for each copy of Chicot.

name: Chicot
text: The Water: Gains the number of discards orig

name: Chicot
text: Painted Deck, Blast Off Deck and Cruelty Deck penalize holding non-scoring Jokers like Chicot with their reduced Joker slots.

name: Chicot
text: As Luchador also disable Boss blinds, functionally overlapping with Chicot, Luchador becomes a redundant pickup.

name: Chicot
text: Matador also does not work, as it activates based on Boss Blind effects.

name: Chicot
text: The Director's Cut and Retcon vouchers are usually made obsolete with the possession of Chicot, since Boss Blind effects are no longer a concern.

name: Chicot
text: While normally it's not too big of a problem, do note that Amber Acorn shuffles Jokers before Chicot disables it, which can be annoying sometimes.

name: Chicot
text: Any run that relies on The Serpent's effect will no longer work with Chicot.

name: Clever Joker
text: Abandoned Deck and Mad World Deck work well with this Joker thanks to their smaller deck, allowing you to find a Two Pair easier.

name: Clever Joker
text: Erratic Deck can work well with this Joker if it randomizes a lot of cards with the same rank.

name: Clever Joker
text: Plasma Deck benefits from the large amount of chips, which, when balanced, greatly boost the score for the played hand.

name: Clever Joker
text: Any Poker Hand that contains a Two Pair will benefit from Clever Joker. These are:

name: Clever Joker
text: Two Pair

name: Clever Joker
text: Full House

name: Clever Joker
text: Flush House

name: Clever Joker
text: Flush - only if the flush contains a Two Pair

name: Clever Joker
text: Four of a Kind and similar hands do not trigger Clever Joker.

name: Clever Joker
text: Spare Trousers gains Mult when playing a Two Pair.

name: Clever Joker
text: Square Joker gains Chips any time a played hand consists of exactly 4 cards. Since a standard Two Pair is exactly four cards, the player can strengthen Square Joker while getting Chips from Clever Joker.

name: Clever Joker
text: Jolly Joker and Mad Joker give Mult on a Pair and Two Pair respectively.

name: Clever Joker
text: Sly Joker gives Chips if the played hand contains a Pair.

name: Clever Joker
text: The Duo provides a X2 Mult boost when playing a Two Pair.

name: Cloud 9
text: Any Deck can use Cloud 9 effectively, as it pays out whenever a round is completed as long as the player has at least one 9 in their full Deck.

name: Cloud 9
text: Black Deck can benefit from Cloud 9 thanks to its +1 Joker Slot. Because of the -1 hand per blind penalty, Cloud 9 can help offset the lower income from early games.

name: Cloud 9
text: Green Deck: This Deck likes to have extra income sources in the absence of interest, so something like Cloud 9 is a natural inclusion.

name: Cloud 9
text: Yellow Deck: This Joker will help maintain the interest cap when acquired in the mid-game, further increasing the already-strong buying power it has.

name: Cloud 9
text: Ghost Deck, Magic Deck, and Zodiac Deck: All these Decks have easier access to Deck fixing to include a higher amount of 9s in the Deck. Of these, Ghost Deck is probably the best to choose, as its starting Hex Spectral card makes it more practical to keep this Joker for the long run by allowing it to help with scoring.

name: Cloud 9
text: Since players are encouraged to create lots of 9s to increase Cloud 9's benefit, hands which use many of the same rank are recommended.

name: Cloud 9
text: Three of a Kind

name: Cloud 9
text: Four of a Kind

name: Cloud 9
text: Five of a Kind

name: Cloud 9
text: Flush Five

name: Cloud 9
text: Tarot card generation is extremely important if the maximization of Cloud 9's value is the goal. Cartomancer is the most effective one, creating a Tarot card whenever a Blind is selected (a Cloud 9 build would not want to skip in the first place in order t

name: Cloud 9
text: Painted Deck, Blast Off Deck and Cruelty Deck: The reduced Joker slots makes it difficult to carry Cloud 9 since players may need more scoring Jokers to survive and beat Ante 8.

name: Constellation
text: Nebula Deck begins with the Telescope Voucher, allowing the player to purchase a Planet card of the most played Poker Hand each time a Celestial Pack is opened.

name: Constellation
text: Zodiac Deck begins with the Planet Merchant Voucher making Planet cards have a x2 chance of appearing.

name: Constellation
text: Since Constellation levels up regardless of the Planet cards' type, any poker Hand has synergy with it.

name: Constellation
text: Economy Jokers (ex. Business Card, Golden Joker, Cloud 9, etc.) are important to help scale Constellation, since they allow the player to purchase more Celestial Packs and Planet cards from the Shop.

name: Constellation
text: Notably, Satellite provides more money for each unique Planet card used.

name: Constellation
text: Chaos the Clown gives a free reroll in the Shop allowing for more Planet cards to be found.

name: Constellation
text: Mime is able to retrigger a Blue Seal, allowing for two Planet cards to be created, instead of one.

name: Constellation
text: Astronomer makes every Planet card and Celestial Pack in the Shop free, thus giving free upgrades to Constellation.

name: Constellation
text: Certificate can generate cards with a Blue Seal, granting a repeatable source of Planet cards.

name: Constellation
text: As Perkeo gives a copy of a random consumable at the end of the Shop, the player should keep a Planet card of their best poker hand to obtain more, and scale Constellation.

name: Constellation
text: Overstock and Overstock Plus respectively add

name: Constellation
text: Red Card encourages skipping Celestial Packs instead of using the Planet cards in them.

name: Constellation
text: Campfire incentives the player to sell Planet cards instead of using them.

name: Constellation
text: Skipping for Throwback or Diet Cola likely means fewer Planet cards to find or use, although this becomes viable if the Meteor Tag is involved.

name: Constellation
text: Tarot Merchant, Tarot Tycoon, and Magic Trick reduce the probabilities of Planet cards appearing in the shop.

name: Constellation
text: The Blast Off Deck challenge starts the player with an Eternal copy of Constellation.

name: Crafty Joker
text: Checkered Deck works best with Crafty Joker thanks to its 2 suits, allowing Flushes to be reliably formed.

name: Crafty Joker
text: Plasma Deck benefits from the large amount of chips, which, when balanced, greatly boost the score for the played hand.

name: Crafty Joker
text: Playing any kind of Flush will trigger Crafty Joker. This includes:

name: Crafty Joker
text: Flush

name: Crafty Joker
text: Straight Flush

name: Crafty Joker
text: Flush House

name: Crafty Joker
text: Flush Five

name: Crafty Joker
text: Smeared Joker and Four Fingers make it easier to play Flushes.

name: Crafty Joker
text: Droll Joker gives +10 Mult when playing a Flush.

name: Crafty Joker
text: The Tribe gives X2 Mult when playing a Flush.

name: Crafty Joker
text: Tarot cards:

name: Crafty Joker
text: The Moon, The Star, The Sun, and The World turn cards into Clubs, Diamonds, Hearts, and Spades, respectively, which can be useful if the player wants their deck to focus on one or two suits.

name: Crafty Joker
text: The Hanged Man can be useful for cutting unwanted cards out the deck if the player wants to focus on one particular card suit.

name: Crafty Joker
text: The Lovers turns a card into a Wild, which can be useful for forming a Flush if the player needs another card.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Red Deck is good with this joker, as more discards can help you get a Straight.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Nebula Deck can be good, as having your hands be mainly Straight means having your planet packs contain Saturn helps.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Abandoned Deck and Mad World Deck both have fewer cards than a standard deck, which makes Straights easier to make.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Painted Deck gives extra hand size, which can help the player with forming Straights.

name: Crazy Joker
text: 15 Minute City Deck starts with an Eternal Shortcut, which allows Straights to be made with gaps in them, making it easier to get that hand.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Crazy Joker affects both Straights and Straight Flushes.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Devious Joker, Runner, and The Order will always activate at the same time as this Joker, as well as possibly Superposition and Séance, though those are more specific.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Four Fingers and Shortcut both help in making Straights easier.

name: Crazy Joker
text: As you are mainly just going for the same hand constantly, Supernova, Space Joker, and Card Sharp are good.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Wasteful and Recyclomancy give additional discards, allowing the player to search for Straight hands easier.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Paint Brush and Palette both increase hand size, which can help players with forming Straights.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Telescope can help upgrade Straights using Saturn.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Erratic Deck has anti-synergy, as it is generally harder to create Straights with this deck.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Five-Card Draw Deck's -3 hand size makes it extremely hard to assemble Straights.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Jokers that reduce hand size, like Stuntman and Merry Andy, have anti-synergy with Crazy Joker, as a smaller hand size makes it harder to assemble Straights.

name: Crazy Joker
text: Ectoplasm and Ouija have anti-synergy with Crazy Joker, as a smaller hand size makes it harder to assemble Straights. Not only that, but Ouija converts all cards held in hand into one single rank, which makes assembling Straights less consistent.

name: Crazy Joker
text: The Manacle's -1 hand size makes it hard to assemble Straights.

name: Crazy Joker
text: The Water will always start with 0 discards, making it very hard to assemble Straights.

name: Credit Card
text: Green Deck does not generate interest based on current money, which means being in debt does not hinder your income.

name: Credit Card
text: Luxury Tax Deck: When playing this challenge deck, hand size decreases by 1 for every $5, meaning that with a single credit card, the hand size can be increased by up to 4. Additionally, having a credit card makes it easier to avoid the hand size penalty while still being able to buy items from the shop.

name: Credit Card
text: Vagabond allows you to get Tarot cards every time you play a hand with $4 or less. Staying in debt with the Credit Card assures you will create many Tarot cards.

name: Credit Card
text: Credit Card: Although the wording may make it seem otherwise, multiple copies do stack, allowing you to go up to $40 in debt with two, up to $60 with three, etc., if that's something you would want.

name: Credit Card
text: Credit Card cannot be copied by Blueprint or Brainstorm, but multiple copies can be obtained via Showman, Invisible Joker, or Ankh.

name: Credit Card
text: The Ox: Playing your most played hand this run sets money to $0, which can be used to wipe out Credit Card's debt.

name: Credit Card
text: The Tooth: Losing money is less detrimental with the ability to go into debt, but be careful, as you may lose a lot of money and go deeply below -$20.

name: Credit Card
text: Wraith sets your money to $0 after use, meaning you gain money i

name: Credit Card
text: Rich get Richer Deck: Since chips cannot exceed the current money, being in debt will prevent the player from scoring any points at all.

name: Credit Card
text: To the Moon: Without any money, no interest can be generated.

name: Credit Card
text: Bull does not have any effect if you don't have any money.

name: Credit Card
text: Bootstraps also has no effect for the same reason.

name: Credit Card
text: Seed Money and Money Tree: No interest can be earned if the player is in debt.

name: Credit Card
text: The Hermit Tarot card (which normally doubles your money) gives no money if you have $0 or less.

name: Credit Card
text: The Inflation Deck and Golden Needle Deck challenges start the player with a copy of Credit Card.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Red Deck provides an additional discard, which increases the money earned when this Joker is triggered.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Painted Deck has a larger hand size, which increases the likelihood of drawing a strong Poker Hand without discarding.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Green Deck already incentivizes using few discards.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Five-Card Draw Deck and Golden Needle Deck both start with 6 discards, which means Delayed Gratification can provide $12 if no discards are used. However, Golden Needle Deck starts with only 1 hand, which can make it awkward to use Delayed Gratification.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: This Joker disincentivizes discarding, so it is recommended to play more common poker hands like High Card, Pair, Two Pair, or Three of a Kind.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Works well with any Jokers that reward you for not discarding, especially Banner, Green Joker, and Ramen.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Any Joker that increases the number of discards (for example, Drunkard or Merry Andy) will benefit Delayed Gratification.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Though Merry Andy decreases hand size, which could make it harder to form hands.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Jokers that make poker hands easier to make, like Shortcut, Four Fingers, or Smeared Joker, give the player an opportunity to win the round without using discards.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Jokers that affect hand size, like Juggler, Turtle Bean, and Troubadour, make it significantly easier to form hands without discarding.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: However, Troubadour has a -1

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Black Deck makes it difficult to use Delayed Gratification due to its -1 hand per round.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Blast Off Deck is even worse due to its -2 hands and -1 discard per round.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Without heavy deck modification, strong five-card hands like Flush, Straight, or Full House will be hard to assemble without using any discards.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Burglar removes all discards, rendering Delayed Gratification useless.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Jokers that encourage discarding, like Castle, Mail-In Rebate, Faceless Joker, Burnt Joker, and Yorick, all have anti-synergy with Delayed Gratification.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Mystic Summit is especially bad, as it requires having no discards remaining.

name: Delayed Gratification
text: Jokers that decrease hand size, like Merry Andy and Stuntman, could make it much harder to form hands, as Delayed Gratification heavily encourages n

name: Delayed Gratification
text: The Hook's forced discards will not prevent Delayed Gratification from taking effect.

name: Devious Joker
text: Abandoned Deck and Mad World Deck both work best with Devious Joker thanks to their smaller card count, allowing Straights to be formed easier.

name: Devious Joker
text: Painted Deck also works well with Devious Joker thanks to its larger hand size, allowing Straights to be formed easier.

name: Devious Joker
text: Plasma Deck benefits from the large amount of chips, which, when balanced, greatly boost the score for the played hand.

name: Devious Joker
text: 15 Minute City Deck starts with an Eternal Shortcut, which allows Straights to be made with gaps in them, making it easier to get that hand.

name: Devious Joker
text: Playing any Straight will trigger Devious Joker, including Straight Flush and Royal Flush.

name: Devious Joker
text: Shortcut allows gaps in Straights, making them easier to find and play.

name: Devious Joker
text: Four Fingers allows Straights of length 4, making them easier to find and play.

text: Runner gains Chips when playing a Straight.

text: Crazy Joker gives +12 Mult when playing a Straight.

text: Five-Card Draw Deck's -3 hand size makes it extremely hard to assemble Straights.
