name: Diet Cola
text: Black Deck: The +1 Joker slot gives more chances to get Diet Cola without having to sell another Joker.

name: Diet Cola
text: Anaglyph Deck: Diet Cola's Double Tag can stack with the ones obtained after defeating a boss blind.

name: Diet Cola
text: Diet Cola synergizes with just about every build as long as the player has an open Joker slot. It is, in effect, a $3 Double Tag, if it is bought and sold immediately. Any build that is empowered by a tag is inherently empowered by buying and selling Diet Cola, unless the act of selling another Joker to make room for it temporarily is a negative act that outweighs the benefits the Double Tag gives. It is recommended to read up on all the Tags available to see all the potential synergies, as there are too many to list here.

name: Diet Cola
text: Some particular Jokers that work well with Diet Cola:

name: Diet Cola
text: By definition, it is very strong with Throwback, as the player can get even more value out of skipping blinds (though Throwback does not receive additional scaling for each double tag spent).

name: Diet Cola
text: Diet Cola very mildly synergizes with Gift Card, as if the player waits a few rounds before selling the cola, they will lose less money overall.

name: Diet Cola
text: Selling Diet Cola can also help proc Campfire.

name: Diet Cola
text: Blueprint and Brainstorm are compatible with Diet Cola, selling either one while they are copying Diet Cola will also create a Double Tag. This would not be advisable, however, as Blueprint and Brainstorm are far more valuable than the Do

name: Diet Cola
text: The Non-Perishable Deck challenge bans Diet Cola.

name: DNA
text: Blue Deck gives an additional hand to play, which can be used to trigger DNA with fewer consequences.

name: DNA
text: Red Deck gives an additional discard, which can help in finding a specific card for DNA to copy.

name: DNA
text: Erratic Deck starts with uneven ranks and suits, so copying cards with DNA can help further inflate specific ranks/suits, which can allow the player to play higher ranking hands, like Four of a Kind, more consistently.

name: DNA
text: DNA works best with High Card, since it requires a High Card on the first hand to trigger.

name: DNA
text: DNA also works especially well with strong hands that use duplicate cards, like Four of a Kind, Five of a Kind, Flush Five, or Flush House.

name: DNA
text: Hologram increases by X0.25 Mult for every card copied by DNA. As a result, DNA can increase Hologram by X0.75 Mult per ante, on top of whatever other cards can be added to your deck.

name: DNA
text: Blue Joker adds Chips based on the number of cards in the deck, which can be increased by DNA.

name: DNA
text: Blueprint and Brainstorm can be combined with DNA to duplicate a card twice (or thrice if all three Jokers are used together), allowing the player to quickly fill the deck with high value cards. Additionally, it allows the player to immediately use more copies of the card they played. With all three jokers, playing one card will put three copies in hand, for a net of two extra copies available to use.

name: DNA
text: Trading Card pairs

name: DNA
text: Black Deck, Blast Off Deck, and Golden Needle Deck all reduce the number of hands to play, which can discourage using DNA while a player's hands aren't strong enough.

name: DNA
text: Golden Needle Deck is especially bad, as it only starts with one hand, which means that without a strong High Card build, DNA is unlikely to be a useful purchase.

name: DNA
text: DNA is weakest when building for Straight or Straight Flush, because it is harder to duplicate cards into runs than it is to duplicate cards into sets.

name: DNA
text: Erosion's effect depends on having fewer cards than you started with, and the cards added by DNA make it very difficult to get and stay under that limit.

name: DNA
text: Unless with a build around High Cards, triggering DNA will waste one hand per round, which means Ice Cream and Seltzer will be depleted more quickly.

name: Driver's License
text: Yellow Deck: The bonus $10 allows for better econ in early to mid game to afford Booster packs.

name: Driver's License
text: Magic Deck: Starting with two copies of The Fool, this can get the player's number of enhanced cards up to 6 at the first shop, nearly half of the required amount to activate Driver's License.

name: Driver's License
text: Zodiac Deck: Increased Tarot cards in shop means more chance to get enhancement cards.

name: Driver's License
text: Anaglyph Deck: Skipping for Charm Tag, Ethereal Tag or Standard Tag can accelerate Driver's License.

name: Driver's License
text: Fragile Deck starts with all 52 cards as Glasss, meaning that Driver's License will be immediately activated, but be aware if your deck reaches to 15 or less cards.

name: Driver's License
text: On a similar note, Medusa Deck starts with 12 Stones and an Eternal Marble Joker, meaning that Driver's License will become active after Round 4

name: Driver's License
text: Jokers that add enhanced cards to your deck or change cards into enhanced ones like Marble Joker, Midas Mask, or DNA can help activate Driver's License a lot sooner.

name: Driver's License
text: Combining Midas Mask with Pareidolia is extremely effective for this instance as it can turn all scored cards into Golds, activating Driver's License at a record pace.

name: Driver's License
text: Vagabond can also create many enhanced cards very quickly.

name: Driver's License
text: Nebula Deck works somewhat poorly with Driver's License, as its -1 consumable slot penalty does not allow for many useful consumables to be held at once.

name: Driver's License
text: Blast Off Deck makes Driver's License harder to activate due to the starting Planet Merchant and Planet Tycoon vouchers, which reduce the probabilities of Tarot cards appearing in the shop.

name: Driver's License
text: Vampire is not a good Joker to combine with Driver's License, as any played enhanced card will get the enhancement removed and leave Driver's License useless.

name: Driver's License
text: Planet Merchant and Planet Tycoon reduce the probability of Tarot cards appearing in the shop.

name: Droll Joker
text: Magic Deck helps a fair amount in getting flushes, as multiple tarot cards can change a card into a certain suit.

name: Droll Joker
text: Ghost Deck, like the Magic Deck, helps as a lot of Spectral cards may help in getting a lot of your cards into one Suit.

name: Droll Joker
text: Checkered Deck may be the best deck for this Joker, as flushes are extremely easy due to the deck only containing two suits to start with.

name: Droll Joker
text: Zodiac Deck can help you buy tarot cards to change your deck into one suit.

name: Droll Joker
text: Erratic Deck can sometimes be extremely good for flushes, depending on the contents of your deck.

name: Droll Joker
text: This Joker works with Flush and Straight Flush as well as 2 of the hidden hands, Flush House and Flush Five.

name: Droll Joker
text: Crafty Joker and The Tribe always activate at the same time as this Joker.

name: Droll Joker
text: Four Fingers and Smeared Joker help in making it easier to create flushes.

name: Droll Joker
text: Depending on your deck and which suit you are playing off of, one of the pairs of Greedy Joker/Rough Gem, Lusty Joker/Bloodstone, Wrathful Joker/Arrowhead or Gluttonous Joker/Onyx Agate can work for diamonds, hearts, spades and clubs respectively.

name: Droll Joker
text: Tarot cards:

name: Droll Joker
text: The Moon, The Star, The Sun, and The World turn cards into Clubs, Diamonds, Hearts, and Spades, respectively, which can be useful if the player wants their deck to focus on one or two suits.

name: Drunkard
text: Green Deck in particular synergizes well as the player earns money for leftover discards.

name: Drunkard
text: All hands can benefit from Drunkard, as it makes it easier to search for the desired cards.

name: Drunkard
text: Drunkard has synergy with:

name: Drunkard
text: Jokers that activate when discarding specific cards, suits, or hands:

name: Drunkard
text: Trading Card when discarding a single card.

name: Drunkard
text: Hit the Road when discarding Jacks.

name: Drunkard
text: Faceless Joker when discarding 3+ face cards.

name: Drunkard
text: Burnt Joker when discarding any Poker Hand.

name: Drunkard
text: Mail-In Rebate when discarding the random rank chosen.

name: Drunkard
text: Castle when discarding the random suit chosen.

name: Drunkard
text: "Remaining discards" Jokers:

name: Drunkard
text: Banner gives more chips if the player has more discards.

name: Drunkard
text: Delayed Gratification provides $2 per discard if no discards are used.

name: Drunkard
text: Jokers that want to play a specific, difficult to find hand:

name: Drunkard
text: Séance wants to play a Straight Flush.

name: Drunkard
text: Superposition wants to play a Straight that includes an Ace.

name: Drunkard
text: Card Sharp wants you to play the same Poker Hand twice.

name: Drunkard
text: The Family wants to play a Four of a Kind.

name: Drunkard
text: Yorick to help scale Yorick faster.

name: Drunkard
text: Purple Seal: The extra discard provides more opportunities to generate more Tarot cards.

name: Drunkard
text: Drunkard restores a discard lost from playing Blue Stake and above.

name: Drunkard
text: Burglar as it removes all discards (no matter the order of the 2 Jokers).

name: Drunkard
text: Green Joker as it gets -1 Mult for every discard used.

name: Drunkard
text: Ramen as any discard reduces its X Mult.

name: Drunkard
text: The Water will always set your discards to 0, making Drunkard useless.

name: Dusk
text: Black Deck reduces the available Hands for the player by -1, making it less punishing for the player to use their final hand.

name: Dusk
text: Similarly, Blast Off Deck reduces the available Hands for the player by -2, making it less punishing for the player to use their final hand.

name: Dusk
text: Golden Needle Deck reduces the player's Hands to 1, meaning Dusk is automatically activated.

name: Dusk
text: Dusk works best with five card hands, such as Flushes and Straights, due to these giving Dusk more cards to retrigger, thus giving a higher score.

name: Dusk
text: Dusk synergizes well with Hack when playing low-ranked cards, as they allow each card to be triggered three times.

name: Dusk
text: Similarly to Hack, Sock and Buskin synergizes well with Dusk, as it allows face cards to be triggered more.

name: Dusk
text: Acrobat is a good pair with Dusk, provided players have a lot of Mult cards and +Mult Jokers ready for the final hand.

name: Dusk
text: Troubadour's -1 Hand penalty becomes mostly irrelevant as Dusk only activates on the final hand.

name: Dusk
text: As with all retrigger Jokers, any Joker that cares about certain cards being scored goes well with Dusk. Notable examples are Bloodstone and Triboulet, as their X Mult effects stack.

name: Dusk
text: Hiker has incredible synergy with Dusk, as not only will Hiker scale cards twice as fast, but the retriggering of the cards will also give their chips again.

name: Dusk
text: Green Deck gives no interest, instead gaining $2/Hand and $1/Discard remaining. Using all your hands to trigger Dusk means losing most of your income.

name: Dusk
text: Dusk will deplete Seltzer and Ice Cream faster, as Dusk requires the player to exhaust all hands to trigger.

name: Dusk
text: If Crimson Heart debuffs Dusk on the final hand, it cannot retrigger any card.

name: Egg
text: The Green Deck cannot generate interest, and can especially benefit from alternative income sources like Egg.

name: Egg
text: This Joker does not add Chips or Mult, so no hand benefits or suffers from it.

name: Egg
text: Swashbuckler can combo with Egg to gain Mult each round, but will lose it if Egg is sold. While Debuffed, Egg will still provide Mult for Swashbuckler.

name: Egg
text: Ceremonial Dagger can be used to sacrifice Egg for a permanent Mult bonus.

name: Egg
text: The money given by Temperance scales with the sell value of the player's Jokers. The longer players have Egg, the more money they'll get from Temperance, even potentially hitting the maximum value of $50 they can get from the Tarot card.

name: Egg
text: Hieroglyph and Petroglyph send the player back an Ante, giving players more time to scale Egg's sell value.

name: Egg
text: Anaglyph Deck incentives skipping blinds due to its Double Tag gimmick, which gives Egg less chances to increase its sell value.

name: Egg
text: Since Painted Deck and Blast Off Deck only have 4 Joker slots instead of the typical 5, taking Egg is much more risky since it doesn't immediately help the player score and its only purpose is to be sold.

name: Egg
text: Cruelty Deck makes it even more difficult and risky to use Egg, as this deck only has 3 Joker slots.

name: Egg
text: Non-Perishable Deck makes every Joker Eternal, including Egg, which means it cannot be sold.

name: Egg
text: Throwback encourages skipping blinds to scale the X Mult of the Joker, once again giving Egg less opportunity to increase its sell value.

name: Egg
text: On Black Stake and above, there is a chance for an Egg to be Eternal, which makes it impossible to sell if picked up, nullifyin

name: Egg
text: The Omelette Deck challenge starts the player with 5 copies of Egg.

name: Erosion
text: Erosion has synergy with all decks, since most players generally want to reduce their deck size anyway in order to draw more reliably. However, it is especially powerful when used with these decks:

name: Erosion
text: Zodiac Deck can provide more Tarot cards in the Shop with its starting Tarot Merchant, potentially increasing the odds of getting The Hanged Man.

name: Erosion
text: Ghost Deck allows for Spectral cards to appear in the Shop, which can potentially include Immolate.

name: Erosion
text: Erosion works extremely well on Fragile Deck, as the player starts with a 52 card deck full of Glasss that are guaranteed to break by virtue of having 2 Oops! All 6s upon starting the challenge.

name: Erosion
text: If the player can choose which cards to destroy, it may be useful to build towards higher-scoring hands, such as Four of a Kind or Full House. If not, it may be best to focus on smaller hands, such as Two Pair or Three of a Kind.

name: Erosion
text: Trading Card is able to destroy one card once per round giving Erosion +4 Mult each time.

name: Erosion
text: Sixth Sense can destroy a 6 once per round, and potentially provide an Immolate card.

name: Erosion
text: Tarot generating Jokers like Cartomancer or Vagabond can give access to The Hanged Man and Justice, or The Fool to copy them.

name: Erosion
text: Abandoned Deck might have anti-synergy with Erosion, as it has only 40 cards instead of 52. Since there are less cards, erosion has a lower ceiling on the maximum mult it can give.

name: Erosion
text: Mad World Deck starts with a 32 card deck, making it extremely difficult to earn value from Erosion with a ceiling even lower than the Abandoned Deck.

name: Erosion
text: Medusa Deck and Monolith Deck don't work well with Erosion, as these decks both start with an Eternal Marble Joker, which makes Erosion very hard to scale.

name: Erosion
text: Blue Joker gives additional + Chips based on the size of player's deck, so it will provide less benefit as the player reduces their deck size for Erosion.

name: Erosion
text: Jokers that add playing cards to the player's deck reduce the amount of + Mult Erosion can provide.

name: Even Steven
text: Even Steven is a decent source of +Mult that triggers through cards, effectively being +20 Mult if all played cards are even and trigger once. It works very well as an early-game source of Mult, but can fall off unless heavily built around (and even then, it isn't the best Joker to build around).

name: Even Steven
text: Abandoned Deck works very well with Steven, since it allows the player to find even ranks more easily. It makes even cards about 20% more common to draw (in an unaltered deck).

name: Even Steven
text: Mad World Deck will also work as well, although this deck doesn't start with any 10s.

name: Even Steven
text: Magic Deck's Fools can be used to turn many odd cards into evens with Strengths, or copy a strong even card with Deaths.

name: Even Steven
text: Steven works best with hands that play five even cards. This is mainly Full House, though Four of a Kind may work well with its higher base chips, and later Five of a Kind. Flushes can serve as a decent alternative, since they can be easier to find and will still (ideally) contain some even cards.

name: Even Steven
text: Even Steven is, in essence, a more effective version of the sinful Jokers (the ones that give +3 Mult per scored card of a certain suit). In an unaltered deck, the chance an even card is drawn is ~38%, compared to the 25% of a specific suit, and it gives more Mult. In exchange, it's harder to build around since there are fewer rank-changing methods than suit changers, and it can be harder

name: Faceless Joker
text: Red Deck gives +1 Discard, allowing more chances to discard and dig for face cards.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Golden Needle Deck removes money when discarding, and Faceless Joker is an effective counter to this.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Because this Joker requires discarding face cards, which provide lots of Chips, it's recommended to build toward weaker hands like High Card, Pair, or Two Pair.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Pareidolia makes it so that all cards are considered face cards, effectively guaranteeing $5 per every 3 cards discarded.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Drunkard gives +1 Discard, allowing more chances to find and discard face cards.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Merry Andy gives +3 Discards, allowing more chances to find and discard face cards.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Blueprint and Brainstorm can copy Faceless Joker to effectively double/triple amount of money gained with no downside as they can be moved around to buff scoring Jokers afterward.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Wasteful and Recyclomancy give additional discards, allowing more chances to find and discard face cards.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Abandoned Deck and Medusa Deck start with no face cards, making Faceless Joker useless at the beginning unless paired with Pareidolia.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Blast Off Deck doesn't work well with Faceless Joker, as this deck only starts with 2 discards.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Jokers that benefit from playing or keeping face cards, such as Scary Face or Baron, are worse as Faceless Joker incentivizes discarding face cards. Possible exceptions are if Pareidolia is used or if the deck is heavily manipulated for face cards.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Any Jokers that benefit from not using Discards like Delayed Gratification or Banner have anti-synergy with Faceless Joker.

name: Faceless Joker
text: Burglar removes all discards, effectively disabling Faceless Joker.

name: Faceless Joker
text: The Water starts with 0 discards, making Faceless Joker useless for the round.

name: Faceless Joker
text: The Plant debuffs all face

name: Fibonacci
text: Thanks to the absence of face cards, Abandoned Deck has a greater concentration of cards favorable by Fibonacci, and thus works really well with it.

name: Fibonacci
text: Mad World Deck will also work as well, although this deck doesn't start with any Aces.

name: Fibonacci
text: As Three of a Kind, Full House and Four of a Kind all utilize a number of the same rank, they often work really well with Fibonacci. Low-ended Straight also makes great use of Fibonacci.

name: Fibonacci
text: Flush is difficult early on, but can earn +40 Mult from Fibonacci in an unmodified deck, and diligent suit conversion can make triggering Fibonacci a simple matter of picking ranks.

name: Fibonacci
text: Hack retriggers 2s, 3s and 5s, giving at least +8 Mult when one of the ranks is played and scored.

name: Fibonacci
text: Scholar also triggers off of Aces.

name: Fibonacci
text: Wee Joker gains +8 Chips when a 2 is scored, on top of the +8 Mult provided by Fibonacci.

name: Fibonacci
text: Hanging Chad retriggers the first scoring card in a played hand twice, giving +16 Mult if the first scored card triggers Fibonacci.

name: Fibonacci
text: Ride the Bus accumulates +Mult very easily when paired with Fibonacci, since the player wants to use ranks that are not face cards, boosting Ride the Bus in the process.

name: Fibonacci
text: Shortcut lets the player utilize the rare scenario of the Straight A 3 5 7 8 or A 2 3 5 [6/7] for maximum Fibonacci value. A 2 3 5 8 is, unfortunately, not a valid S

name: Fibonacci
text: 15 Minute City Deck doesn't work well with Fibonacci due to lack of Aces, 2s, and 3s by default.

name: Flash Card
text: Decks that generate more money than usual are stronger with Flash Card, mainly Yellow Deck and Green Deck. Green Deck in particular is good with it early, as one can spend as much money on rerolls as they want without worrying about losing interest.

name: Flash Card
text: Zodiac Deck may work well with Flash Card, as the player may want to reroll frequently to see more Tarot and Planet cards.

name: Flash Card
text: No poker hands inherently work better than others with Flash Card. All potential benefits come from other synergies.

name: Flash Card
text: Chaos the Clown grants 1 free reroll per shop, effectively giving Flash Card +2 Mult gain per shop visit on top of paid rerolls.

name: Flash Card
text: Economy Jokers are critical to Flash Card's success. Being able to get more money translates directly into more Mult. Particularly helpful are scaling Economy Jokers, like Cloud 9 and Rocket, though most of them will work.

name: Flash Card
text: Campfire is very good with Flash Card, as the large amount of rerolls being performed and strong economy allows many cards to be sold, scaling Campfire very high.

name: Flash Card
text: Buying and selling planets from Astronomer found with rerolls will allow you to recuperate some of the money spent from rerolling.

name: Flash Card
text: Other Jokers that give X Mult are helpful, as they allow Flash Card's scaling to be more effective. Particularly, Constellation can scale very quickly, as every reroll can create a planet card.

name: Flash Card
text: As the player will be spending lots of money to scal

name: Flash Card
text: Black Deck starts with -1 Hand per round, making Economy more difficult to set up early game. This directly limits Flash Card's scaling opportunities as less Hands per round earns the player less Money overall when defeating Blinds.

name: Flash Card
text: Similarly, Blast Off Deck starts with -2 hands per round, limiting the player's money even more.

name: Flash Card
text: Golden Needle Deck only starts with 1 hand per round, which means the player will not get money from extra hands under normal circumstances.

name: Flash Card
text: Bull and Bootstraps respectively gain Chips and Mult relative to the player's current Money. Spending Money on rerolls to scale Flash Card will therefore weaken the scoring power of these Jokers.

name: Flash Card
text: The Ox sets the player's Money to 0 upon playing the most played Poker Hand of the run, making it potentially difficult to recover Economy for Flash

name: Flower Pot
text: Abandoned Deck and Mad World Deck are easier to sift through with discards due to their smaller size.

name: Flower Pot
text: Painted Deck and Red Deck are also easier to sift through due to a larger hand size and extra discard, respectively.

name: Flower Pot
text: Wilds work fantastically with Flower Pot as they can count as any suit. However, it should be noted that Wild cards will only count as one suit per card, meaning that a single Wild card cannot earn Flower Pot's X3 Mult on its own. Four Wild cards, or three Wild cards and any non-Wild suited card on the other hand, will always trigger Flower Pot's effect (unless the Wild cards are debuffed, this seems to be a bug). Re-triggering a Wild card does not make it count for multiple suits.

name: Flower Pot
text: Four of a Kind is one of the best poker hands with Flower Pot as it needs four cards of every suit to begin with assuming the player doesn't heavily modify their deck.

name: Flower Pot
text: Straights are a five-card hand that only cares about rank, meaning it's easy to get at least one card of every suit in a hand.

name: Flower Pot
text: Full Houses require five cards to be played, meaning it's easier to get four different suits.

name: Flower Pot
text: Two Pairs require four cards and is easier to assemble than a Four of a Kind. Though, when compared to the other hands, it may be harder to get all four suits in a hand.

name: Flower Pot
text: Splash is easily one of the best Jokers to use with Flower Pot, since it lets t

name: Flower Pot
text: Checkered Deck only has two suits instead of the typical four, meaning that it's impossible to trigger Flower Pot's effect without buying diamond and club cards, creating Wild cards, converting cards to other suits, or using Smeared Joker.

name: Flower Pot
text: Flush-based hands require all 5 cards to be of the same suit. Without using at least 3 Wild cards, or 2 Wild cards and Four Fingers/Splash, Flower Pot will never trigger.

name: Flower Pot
text: Without Splash, High Card, Pair, Three of a Kind will never trigger Flower Pot's X3 Mult as they contain less than four cards.

name: Flower Pot
text: Half Joker will never trigger alongside Flower Pot, as the former one wants to play hands with less than 4 cards.

name: Flower Pot
text: Sigil can be awkward to use due to the uneven suit distribution, making it harder to get all four

name: Fortune Teller
text: Zodiac Deck, with its Tarot Merchant already equipped, benefits greatly from Fortune Teller, as players have more chances to buy and use Tarot cards without having to rely on Booster Packs.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Yellow Deck extra $10 may allow for more Tarot cards to be bought.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Any Poker hand can benefit from Fortune Teller.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Vagabond, Cartomancer, Hallucination, 8 Ball, and Superposition can all provide Tarot cards with which to nourish Fortune Teller.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Chaos the Clown gives a free reroll in the Shop allowing for more Tarot cards to be found.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Certificate can generate cards with a Purple Seal, granting a repeatable source of Tarot cards.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Vampire consumes Enhancements from played cards, making it a good combo with Fortune Teller.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Naturally, every Tarot card benefits Fortune Teller, but there are 2 in particular that benefit the most.

name: Fortune Teller
text: The Emperor provides two Tarot cards.

name: Fortune Teller
text: The Fool can copy a Tarot card to use.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Using these two in conjunction with each other can be a quick way to increase Fortune Teller's Mult.

name: Fortune Teller
text: In addition:

name: Fortune Teller
text: The Wheel of Fortune will scale Fortune Teller regardless if the 1 in 4 chance successfully activates, making it beneficial regardless of the outcome.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Medium creates a Purple Seal, allowing the player to create more Tarot cards.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Blast Off Deck makes Fortune Teller harder to scale due to the starting Planet Merchant and Planet Tycoon vouchers, which reduce the probability of Tarot cards appearing.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Red Card wants to skip Arcana Packs instead of using them, which removes scaling for Fortune Teller.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Campfire requires selling Tarot cards instead of using them, which is the opposite of what Fortune Teller does.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Skipping for Throwback or Diet Cola mean fewer Tarot cards to use, although this isn't too bad if the Skip Tag itself is the Charm Tag.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Planet Merchant, Planet Tycoon, and Magic Trick reduce the probabilities of Tarot cards appearing in the shop.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Omen Globe reduces the amount of Tarot cards in Arcana Packs, although it can still be used to find Medium easier.

name: Four Fingers
text: Black Deck: The +1 Joker Slot allows Four Finger to function as a utility Joker while still providing space for 5 other Jokers to score.

name: Four Fingers
text: Checkered Deck: Having only two suits allows a Straight Flush to be formed much easier. For Flush builds on Checkered Deck, a minimum hand size of 9 is required to guarantee every hand contains a flush, but with Four Fingers, a hand size of only 7 is required.

name: Four Fingers
text: Straights and flushes become easier to make as you can score them with only 4 cards, but the biggest benefit will be with the highest scoring, flush-based hands like Straight Flush, Flush House, or Flush Five. Straight flushes, especially, become much easier with Four Fingers as both the "flush" and "straight" parts can be made with 4 different cards out of the 5 played, as described above.

name: Four Fingers
text: Specifically, with Four Fingers, Royal Flush can be made from A K Q J or K Q J 10 of the same suit, or any four of A-10 when combined with Shortcut. This doesn't have much influence on the score but can be used for unlocks like the Royale achievement and Brainstorm's unlock condition.

name: Four Fingers
text: Similar things occur with Flush House and Flush Five, where only 4 of the cards need to be of the same suit. However, unlike straight flushes, the 5th card does still matter in terms of rank in order for the Full House/Five of a Kind hand type to be made.

name: Four Fingers
text: Shortcut makes stra

name: Four Fingers
text: Four Fingers is slightly weaker than Shortcut in creating Straights[https://www.reddit.com/r/balatro/comments/1b68mpp/statistical_analysis_of_the_four_fingers_and/ Statistical Analysis of the "Four Fingers" and "Shortcut" Jokers for Straights], a Reddit post and weaker than Smeared Joker in creating Flushes. However, it can serve these purposes with just one Joker. The player can choose from these Jokers based on the play style of a run.

name: Gift Card
text: Black Deck and Magic Deck can benefit from Gift Card thanks to increased Joker and Consumable slots, allowing more items to be stored.

name: Gift Card
text: Five-Card Draw Deck's increased Joker slots also benefits from Gift Card, as it allows even more items to be stored.

name: Gift Card
text: This Joker doesn't synergise with any Poker Hand.

name: Gift Card
text: Swashbuckler combined with Gift Card, can be used for scaling Mult.

name: Gift Card
text: Ceremonial Dagger can consume Gift Card or other jokers scaled by Gift Card for Mult.

name: Gift Card
text: Cartomancer (and all other jokers that create Tarot cards): Can create the Temperance card, which can generate money equal to the sell value of each of your jokers. Additionally, the tarot cards created this way sell for $1 dollar extra per round because of Gift Card.

name: Gift Card
text: The money given by Temperance scales with the sell value of the player's Jokers. The longer players have Gift Card, the more money they'll get from Temperance, even potentially hitting the maximum value of $50 they can get from the Tarot card.

name: Gift Card
text: Crystal Ball adds an additional Consumable slot, allowing for more consumables to gain sell price per round.

name: Gift Card
text: Antimatter similarly adds an additional Joker slot, allowing for another joker to gain sell price per round.

name: Gift Card
text: Anaglyph Deck incentivizes skipping blinds due to its Double Tag gimmick, which gives Gift Card less chances to scale the sell value of Jokers and Consumables.

name: Gift Card
text: Painted Deck, Blast Off Deck, and Nebula Deck don't synergize well with Gift Card due to -1 Joker slot and -1 Consumable slot, respectively.

name: Gift Card
text: Cruelty Deck makes it even more difficult to use Gift Card due to -2 Joker slots.

name: Gift Card
text: Throwback encourages skipping blinds to scale the X Mult of the Joker, once again giving Gift Card less opportunity to increase the sell value of Jokers and Consumables.

name: Glass Joker
text: Zodiac Deck gives more opportunity to buy both Justice and The Hanged Man directly from the shop.

name: Glass Joker
text: Anaglyph Deck, with its Double Tag provided after each Boss Blind, may allow players to gain many Charm Tags, or buff up their money to invest in Arcana Packs later in the run.

name: Glass Joker
text: Fragile Deck works very well with Glass Joker, as this deck starts with two Oops! All 6s and all cards are Glasss, which makes Glass Joker scale much faster.

name: Glass Joker
text: Any hand that contains a scoring Glass card will have a chance to buff Glass Joker.

name: Glass Joker
text: Splash: This allows up to five Glass cards to be played at once, in the event that the Glass cards cannot form an ideal poker hand. While also giving more X2 Mult boosts that can potentially make or break a run, it most importantly gives extra chances at breaking Glass cards, thereby scaling Glass Joker at a faster rate.

name: Glass Joker
text: Erosion: An Additive Mult Joker that scales remarkably fast as the number of cards in your full deck drops below the starting amount. Even destroying single-digit numbers of Glass cards can give it up to +36 Mult, which, in turn, will pair very nicely with this Joker's at-times simultaneous Multiplicative Mult scaling.

name: Glass Joker
text: Oops! All 6s: With this Joker equipped, Glass cards will break half of the time, making the rate at which Glass Joker scales much faster. This comes at the downside of exhausting your deck at

name: Glass Joker
text: Bram Poker Deck starts with an Eternal Vampire, which means Glass Joker will not gain anything unless you use The Hanged Man or Trading Card.

name: Glass Joker
text: Vampire is not recommended, as it removes any Glass enhancement when scored, and players might need to destroy Glass cards by using The Hanged Man or Trading Card.

name: Glass Joker
text: Due to a bug, Immolate, Grim, Incantation, and Familiar destroying Glasss will NOT scale Glass Joker, wasting the Enhancement while not providing any value, although the latter 3 can be used to create more Glass cards to destroy.

name: Glass Joker
text: Glass Joker will only appear in the shop after you have at least one Glass in your deck.

name: Glass Joker
text: To unlock this Joker, the player must have at least 5 Glasss in the deck

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Magic Deck's Fool Tarots can be used to mass-convert cards to have Club suits.

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Ghost Deck can find a Sigil Spectral card in the shop, which may convert cards into Clubs.

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: This Joker works best with Flush hands, if they contain only Club suit cards. These hands are as follows:

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Flush

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Straight Flush (and Royal Flush)

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Flush House

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Flush Five

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Other hands that score more cards are generally better to play with Gluttonous Joker, as they allow more Club cards to be scored.

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: As Gluttonous Joker's effect triggers when a Club card is scored, retrigger Jokers that allow cards to be scored multiple times are very good to combo with Gluttonous.

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Flush Jokers, like Crafty Joker and Droll Joker, work well with Gluttonous Joker, as you want to be playing flushes to maximize its effect anyways.

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Onyx Agate also triggers off of Club cards scored, forming a natural synergy with Gluttonous Joker. As Onyx Agate is a strict upgrade to Gluttonous, it can be used as a replacement, but it also can be used in builds that have high X Mult from hands from Jokers like, sometimes, Ancient Joker, or The Idol. This combo also benefits from a strong Chip Joker, ideally one that also benefits from Flushes. Castle is the best example of this kind of Joker.

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Because Gluttonous Joker's Mult is applied during the scoring of your played cards, Jokers that focus

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: Checkered Deck starts with no Clubs, making Gluttonous Joker less useful.

name: Gluttonous Joker
text: When facing The Club, all Club cards are debuffed, meaning Gluttonous Joker cannot activate.

name: Golden Joker
text: Green Deck appreciates other sources of income, especially if you are using all of your hands/discards.

name: Golden Joker
text: Black Deck can synergy with Golden Joker thanks to the +1 Joker Slot, plus its -1 hand per round means players need something to boost their income anyway.

name: Golden Joker
text: Zodiac Deck generally wants to reroll a lot, meaning Golden Joker's money can help with that.

name: Golden Joker
text: This Joker doesn't synergize with any poker hands.

name: Golden Joker
text: Economy-based scalers, like Bull and Flash Card, appreciate the extra money brought in by Golden Joker.

name: Golden Joker
text: Golden Joker can be used to help jump start To the Moon, achieving higher interest levels sooner. To the Moon is, with $25 held, a strict upgrade to Golden Joker.

name: Golden Joker
text: Tarot generators can be useful with Golden Joker, since the money Golden provides can increase the value of The Hermit. Temperance also likes Golden Joker, as it has a base sell value of $3.

name: Golden Joker
text: The Omelette Deck challenge bans Golden Joker.

name: Golden Ticket
text: The Zodiac Deck works best with Golden Ticket thanks to its increased Tarot card frequency, allowing Gold card conversion more frequent.

name: Golden Ticket
text: Playing 5-card hand such as Flush or Full House with as many Gold cards as possible will ensure maximum income.

name: Golden Ticket
text: "On scored" retrigger Jokers will reactivate Golden Ticket's effect. So Hanging Chad, Dusk, and Seltzer are great with this Joker. Hack and Sock and Buskin can also be great if the Gold cards have the relevant ranks.

name: Golden Ticket
text: Midas Mask turns all face cards into Gold cards when scored. It will be even stronger if paired with Pareidolia, as all cards now can be converted into Gold cards.

name: Golden Ticket
text: Bull and Bootstraps benefit from the high money making capabilities of this joker.

name: Golden Ticket
text: A Gold Seal will earn $3 when scored, giving $7 total per Gold card.

name: Golden Ticket
text: A Red Seal will retrigger Golden Ticket, giving $8 per Gold card.

name: Golden Ticket
text: The Devil can make more Gold cards.

name: Golden Ticket
text: Death can turn some cards into Gold cards.

name: Golden Ticket
text: The Hanged Man can remove non-Gold cards.

name: Golden Ticket
text: Deja Vu can apply Red Seals onto Gold cards allowing Golden Ticket to generate more money.

name: Golden Ticket
text: Vampire has anti-synergy, as the Gold Enhancement gets removed before it can score. However if the player is also using Midas Mask this becomes a non-issue.

name: Golden Ticket
text: This innately applies to the Bram Poker Deck as it starts with an Eternal Vampire.

name: Golden Ticket
text: Vagabond can have anti-synergy, as having more than $4 during a round will disable its effect. It may be better to keep Gold Enhancement cards in hand and let them trigger when the round ends.

name: Golden Ticket
text: Mime has slight anti-synergy, since a Gold card held in hand with Mime will give $6, more than what Golden Ticket gives for playing Gold cards.

name: Greedy Joker
text: Magic Deck: This Deck has the only innate advantage with this one, as one can turn the starting copies of The Fool into The Star to more rapidly convert their Deck into Diamonds. Death and The Lovers also help build towards this goal, albeit at a slower pace, but in the latter's case, Wild cards synergize with many more Jokers.

name: Greedy Joker
text: Red Deck, Blue Deck, and Painted Deck: These Decks all have bonuses that make it marginally easier to find that key Diamonds Flush, making them slightly more practical overall, but not by a large margin.

name: Greedy Joker
text: The most obvious plan with this Joker is to play hands that contain only Diamonds. As a result, Flush-type hands are the most optimal, to guarantee at least +15 Mult to all played hands:

name: Greedy Joker
text: Flush

name: Greedy Joker
text: Straight Flush (and subsequently Royal Flush)

name: Greedy Joker
text: Flush House

name: Greedy Joker
text: Flush Five

name: Greedy Joker
text: Other hands that score more cards, like Straight, are generally better to play with this Joker than, say, High Card or Pair, as they allow more Diamond cards to be scored.

name: Greedy Joker
text: Retrigger Jokers work best with this one. To maximize the Additive Mult boost to +30 Mult on a Flush-type hand, priority should be given to those that can very easily affect the entire hand of played cards, such as Hack (for cards with 5 or lower rank) or Sock and Buskin (for face cards).

name: Greedy Joker
text: Tarot card generation is also a must if

name: Greedy Joker
text: Checkered Deck has anti-synergy with this Joker, since it includes no Diamonds to start. This Joker is better off avoided if encountered while playing this Deck.

name: Greedy Joker
text: Care should be taken when playing a Diamonds Flush build, as they are hard countered by two Boss Blinds, and soft countered by one of the Showdown Blinds. The Director's Cut voucher is a smart choice as a result.

name: Greedy Joker
text: The Window is a debilitating encounter, since it makes it so that all Diamond cards go unscored and thus activate no Joker or card effects. A Diamonds Flush deck is only a safe consideration early on if this Boss Blind has already came and went; in any other case, it is very likely to end the run.

name: Greedy Joker

name: Green Joker
text: Green Joker works with any Deck, with its strength being more pronounced the earlier it is acquired into the run. Decks that have noteworthy synergy include:

name: Green Joker
text: Blue Deck: An extra hand means Green Joker can reach even greater heights by the end of the run. At the very worst, if the player's build is strong enough that a few High Cards are sweeping the Blinds, it translates to an extra $1 at the end of each round.

name: Green Joker
text: Green Deck: This deck benefits from this Joker mainly in the early game when money is low and all hands are used to scale Green Joker, taking advantage of the $1 gained per unused discard. However, other decks would be able to provide more money long-term if the player holds $25 and continues using all hands to scale Green Joker.

name: Green Joker
text: Green Joker works best with hands that can be reliably made without discarding and also played repeatedly, with the rarer hands being less and less reliable. Green Joker wants weaker hands earlier anyway so it can scale more per round, as ending the Blind in one hand will make it scale to about the same size as a fresh Popcorn by the end of a run, far inferior to its usual capabilities.

name: Green Joker
text: This means it works best when playing:

name: Green Joker
text: High Card (especially so, as it is always assembled)

name: Green Joker
text: Pair

name: Green Joker
text: Two Pair

name: Green Joker
text: Another possible strategy is to scale up one of the stronger hands like Straight or Four of a Kind, then use all but one of the hands as

name: Green Joker
text: Black Deck, Blast Off Deck, and Golden Needle Deck all have poor synergy with Green Joker due to their reduced number of hands.

name: Green Joker
text: Red Deck: The +1 discard bonus is completely redundant to a Green Joker build, which should only be using discards in emergencies anyway.

name: Green Joker
text: Anaglyph Deck: Skipping Blinds to get extra Tags means not getting those extra Mult points on this Joker, which, in very extreme circumstances, could spell the player's demise. Given the power of stacking Tags, however, this is usually a nonissue.

name: Green Joker
text: Green Joker has anti-synergy with any Joker related to using discards in almost every circumstance. This includes Jokers such as:

name: Green Joker
text: Faceless Joker

name: Green Joker
text: Mail-In Rebate

name: Green Joker

name: Green Joker
text: Mystic Summit (without Burglar)

name: Green Joker

name: Gros Michel
text: Oops! All 6s: Obtaining these two Jokers simultaneously can either be an immense boon or a huge risk, depending on the state of the run. Increasing the self-destruction odds to a 2 in 6 chance allows for Cavendish to appear faster, at the cost of a potentially run-saving Additive Mult bonus.

name: Gros Michel
text: Copying Gros Michel with Blueprint and Brainstorm does not increase the probability of self-destruction of Gros Michel or cause the copying Joker to self-destruct, so this can be used without additional risks.

name: Gros Michel
text: Gros Michel does not work as well on Plasma Deck compared to other decks, as Additive Mult is not as powerful on this deck.

name: Gros Michel
text: Gros Michel is essentially a must take in the early Antes; with it, most Two Pairs (16 combined rank or higher), any Three of a Kind, or any higher ranked hand is guaranteed to clear each Blind of Ante 1, and any of the common 5-card hands (Straight, Flush, and Full House) can clear up to the Big Blind of Ante 2 on any difficulty without help, provided the chip value is at least 79. Seeing it early also increases the odds of destroying it early, and gaining quick access to Cavendish, a cheap and guaranteed source of Multiplicative Mult. Multiplicative Mult is essentially mandatory to clear the later Antes on any difficulty past Red Stake.

name: Gros Michel
text: Building around Gros Michel will usually end up being a fruitless endeavor, as it can disappear at any moment. However, any build, regardless of synergy, will be happy to pick it up; not only does it provide a powerful bonus before expiry, but exhausting it unlocks the even more powerful Cavendish. Thus, it can supplement any build. Although, if it remains for far too long, it may be necessary to ditch its secret potential in order to pick up a Joker that is more immediately beneficial.

name: Gros Michel
text: It's best to avoid adding any editions to this Joker, since it will be lost when it becomes extinct. Consider holding onto The Wheel of Fortune or Ectoplasm in the consumable area until this Joker destroys itself in order to maximize their v

name: Hack
text: Abandoned Deck and Mad World Deck only have number cards, making it much easier to find low-rank cards.

name: Hack
text: Zodiac Deck can be used to find more Tarot cards to enhance low-rank cards or ways to copy them.

name: Hack
text: Ghost Deck can find powerful seal-applying Spectral cards and Aura, which can make your low-rank cards more impactful.

name: Hack
text: Using large hands that have multiple low-rank cards that can trigger Hack is generally the best option, allowing the player to maximize its potential. Notably, Five of a Kind and Flush Five are easily feasible after duplicating powerful and/or modified low-rank cards. This also includes Full House and Flush House, although they are slightly weaker than the initially mentioned hands. A Straight using Ace, 2, 3, 4, and 5 is also a good way to utilize Hack, although it will not retrigger the Ace.

name: Hack
text: Jokers that are able to give bonuses based on the type of playing card, whether it is suit-based or rank-based, can benefit from Hack. This allows the player to double that Joker's effectiveness.

name: Hack
text: Suit-based Jokers like Greedy Joker, Arrowhead, Gluttonous Joker, etc. can be retriggered if a low-rank card of the corresponding suit is played.

name: Hack
text: Rank-based Jokers like Even Steven, Walkie Talkie, or Odd Todd can benefit from a second tri

name: Hack
text: 15 Minute City Deck doesn't work well with Hack due to a lack of 2s and 3s by default.

name: Half Joker
text: This Joker is very good in the earliest of Antes, with most Pairs and Three of a Kinds able to clear the first one on their own, and is one of the strongest flat Additive Mult Jokers in the game. However, due to the weak base power of the hands it enables, it is usually best replaced by other Additive Mult Jokers in later Antes.

name: Half Joker
text: Blue Deck: This Joker works best when repeatedly playing the hands it enables. Therefore, this Deck provides natural synergy, since the small size of all three valid poker hands warrant fewer discards to consistently find and score them.

name: Half Joker
text: Nebula Deck: Since this Deck emphasizes the quick scaling of a single poker hand, it can greatly balloon the power of Half Joker, which already rewards the player for playing the same few hands, with its built-in Telescope Voucher guaranteeing that each Celestial Pack gives a much needed Pluto, Mercury, or Venus, as the three hands this Joker empowers are very weak at base. However, the -1 consumable slot malus can prevent the player from capitalizing on strong consumables like The Chariot Tarot card, or, if somehow generated by Séance or Sixth Sense in the same run, the Deja Vu, Ouija, and Trance Spectral cards.

name: Half Joker

name: Half Joker
text: Jokers oriented towards larger hands will contribute nothing to a Half Joker build. Some of the numerous examples include not being able to get its benefit while also scaling Square Joker, and being unable to capitalize on The Family, which is one of the strongest flat Multiplicative Mult Jokers in the game, and would otherwise be easy to pivot into from a Three of a Kind build.

name: Half Joker
text: Merry Andy: The +3 discards it provides are nice for most other builds, but for Half Joker builds, they are largely irrelevant for the reasons stated multiple times before. Th

name: Hallucination
text: Magic Deck's extra consumable slot is very useful for saving Tarot cards.

name: Hallucination
text: Green Deck encourages the player to spend money as they earn it, which works well with Hallucination.

name: Hallucination
text: Oops! All 6s will guarantee a Tarot card when used with Hallucination.

name: Hallucination
text: Fortune Teller scales with the amount of Tarot cards used, and it's better when used on an Arcana Pack.

name: Hallucination
text: Red Card also has synergy with Booster Packs.

name: Hallucination
text: Blueprint and Brainstorm can copy Hallucination's effect when opening the Booster Packs, meaning there is a chance for 2 or even 3 Tarot cards.

name: Hallucination
text: Campfire can gain X0.25 Mult if the Tarot card that is generated is not necessary, and can be even higher if The Emperor or The High Priestess are generated.

name: Hallucination
text: Driver's License and Vampire can be built around using the Tarot cards that Hallucination generates.

name: Hallucination
text: Crystal Ball gives +1 consumable slot, allowing the player to hold more useful Tarot cards.

name: Hallucination
text: Clearance Sale and Liquidation lower the price of booster packs, making it easier to purchase and generate more Tarot cards.

name: Hallucination
text: Nebula Deck's missing consumable slot makes it significantly harder to hold and use the Tarots from Hallucination.

name: Hanging Chad
text: The need for powerful enhanced cards to use with Hanging Chad makes it important to utilize Tarot cards and/or Spectral cards.

name: Hanging Chad
text: The Zodiac Deck increases the rate of Tarot cards in the Shop with its starting Tarot Merchant voucher.

name: Hanging Chad
text: The Ghost Deck allows for Spectral cards to be found in the Shop, allowing for cards like Aura, Talisman, etc. to be more likely to acquire.

name: Hanging Chad
text: The Yellow Deck and Green Deck can improve the player's early economy to purchase Booster Packs. These include Standard Packs which may have modified cards, reducing the need for further modification.

name: Hanging Chad
text: Cards in a Poker Hand can be rearranged in a player's hand before it is played, such that their highest scoring or most Modified card gets retriggered by Hanging Chad (i.e. the left-most card in a played hand). It does not matter how the cards are re-ordered in a player's Poker Hand. For example, a Straight will still count as one even if its played as Queen, Ace, King, Jack, 10. The Queen, in this case, will have triple its effect this way (e.g. it was a Polychrome Bonus card).

name: Hanging Chad
text: Smaller hands like High Card or Three of a Kind can help mitigate their lack of played scoring cards, by using Hanging Chad. A singular especially powerful card can make triple its impact with this Joker.

name: Hanging Chad
text: Photograph is one of t

name: Hanging Chad
text: Hanging Chad will not retrigger a Red Seal. A card with a Red Seal that is played as the first scoring card will only trigger for a total of four times (once for the initial trigger, twice for Hanging Chad, and once more for the Red Seal).

name: Hanging Chad
text: DNA will not be triggered another two times by Hanging Chad and will only produce one copy of the played card.

name: Hanging Chad
text: To unlock this Joker, the player must beat a Boss Blind with a High Card.

name: Hiker
text: The Abandoned Deck and Mad World Deck both have fewer cards than the standard 52 card deck, making finding the desired cards to level up with Hiker much easier. It also benefits from centralization around certain ranks, as those cards will already be played more often.

name: Hiker
text: The Red Deck allows for +1 discard to find cards more reliably.

name: Hiker
text: The Blue Deck gives a +1 hand allowing the player to score more cards for Hiker.

name: Hiker
text: The Painted Deck increases the player's hand size, making it easier to find desired cards, in addition to making better hands easier to find for those cards.

name: Hiker
text: The Erratic Deck starts with uneven ranks and suits, which can allow the player to score more cards, allowing Hiker to add more bonus chips to said cards.

name: Hiker
text: The Plasma Deck benefits the most from Hiker thanks to its balancing feature, as Chips scale a lot faster than Mult.

name: Hiker
text: Hiker upgrades whenever cards are scored. Naturally, hands with more scoring cards will perform better with Hiker. In particular, Full House, Four of a Kind, Five of a Kind, Flush House, and Flush Five work well as they allow playing multiple of the same rank, upgrading multiple cards of that rank at the same time and making them more appealing and powerful to play in the future.

name: Hiker
text: Retrigger Jokers are invaluable to Hiker's success, as they allow cards to be scored multiple times and get upgraded multiple times. In addition, each scor

name: Hiker
text: Fragile Deck makes Hiker useless, as every played card will be destroyed once played.

name: Hiker
text: Double or Nothing Deck debuffs all cards when scored, which makes it impractical to use Hiker.

name: Hiker
text: High Card and Pair are generally the worst to play with Hiker, as the fewest cards are scored. There are some circumstances where they are decent, but those circumstances are uncommon. High Card and Pair have the least amount of scored playing cards, making it less useful with Hiker since only those cards will be enhanced. However, it is possible to make these poker hands work if the circumstances are right (ex. Splash).

name: Hiker
text: The Pillar debuffs previously played cards of the Ante, potentially reducing Hiker's value.

name: Hit the Road
text: Red Deck may work well with Hit the Road thanks to the +1 discard per round it provides, allowing more Jacks to be discarded.

name: Hit the Road
text: Painted Deck makes drawing Jacks easier thanks to its +2 hand size.

name: Hit the Road
text: Hit the Road can work with any hand, but with less deck fixing, it is better to play small hands, like High Card, Pair, or Three of a Kind. This ensures that you can discard Jacks while keeping cards in hand to score.

name: Hit the Road
text: DNA can create 1 Jack per round (or more with copy effects), increasing the amount that Hit the Road can be scaled. It is especially beneficial to duplicate Purple Seal.

name: Hit the Road
text: Drunkard's +1 Discard allows more Jacks to be found and discarded.

name: Hit the Road
text: Juggler allows for more Jacks to be found and good cards to be held in hand for scoring.

name: Hit the Road
text: Merry Andy gives +3 Discards, allowing more Jacks to be discarded, with the caveat of -1 hand size. The hand size can make Jacks harder to find and force the player to discard fewer Jacks to hold on to scoring cards.

name: Hit the Road
text: Mail-In Rebate is one of the best Jokers to pair with Hit the Road, as the player is already most likely using all of their discards. It can generate an absurd amount of money with good deck fixing.

name: Hit the Road
text: Faceless Joker is more reliable money with less deck fixing required, although it has far less potential profit than Mail-In Rebate.

name: Hit the Road
text: Yorick scales slower than Hit the Road, but its mult

name: Hit the Road
text: Abandoned Deck, Mad World Deck, and Medusa Deck don't work well with Hit the Road due to lack of initial Jacks.

name: Hit the Road
text: Blast Off Deck doesn't work well with Hit the Road, as this deck only starts with 2 discards.

name: Hit the Road
text: Hands that work with multiple numbered cards, like Straight, Full House, Straight Flush, and Flush House, don't work well with Hit the Road because in an ideal deck you would only have Jacks; if not, you have no discards left to find these hands.

name: Hit the Road
text: Burglar removes all Discards, making Hit the Road useless.

name: Hit the Road
text: Any Jokers that disincentivize discarding, like Delayed Gratification, Banner, Green Joker, and Ramen, have poor synergy with Hit the Road.

name: Hit the Road
text: The Water starts with 0 Discards and therefore renders Hit the Road useless.

name: Hit the Road
text: The Mark makes it difficu

name: Hit the Road
text: If the player has multiple copies of Hit the Road, they will all level up if one Jack is discarded.

name: Hologram
text: Ghost Deck offers upside to Hologram thanks to its easier access to Spectral cards, especially those mentioned in the Synergetic Consumables section.

name: Hologram
text: Abandoned Deck and Mad World Deck work well with Hologram thanks to their low amount of starting cards.

name: Hologram
text: Medusa Deck and Monolith Deck both work well with Hologram, as these decks both start with a Marble Joker, which means Hologram gains X0.25 Mult for free each blind.

name: Hologram
text: Hologram can be used with any Poker Hand, but small hands such as High Card or Pair are affected the least when constantly adding new cards to the deck.

name: Hologram
text: DNA duplicates the first card played if it is the only card.

name: Hologram
text: Certificate adds a random playing card to hand when a round starts.

name: Hologram
text: Marble Joker adds a Stone when a Blind is selected.

name: Hologram
text: Blueprint and Brainstorm are powerful on any build, but they are especially useful with Hologram, as they can copy all of DNA, Certificate, Marble Joker, and Hologram itself.

name: Hologram
text: Blue Joker gives Chips for every remaining card in your deck. However, Blue Joker does need to keep cards in the deck.

name: Hologram
text: Trading Card allows you to destroy cards at will, thus preventing the deck from becoming too bloated while keeping the benefit of this Joker.

name: Hologram
text: Vagabond and Cartomancer create Tarots, some of which are useful for handling added cards that aren't

name: Hologram
text: Fragile Deck doesn't work well with Hologram due to all sources of adding playing cards besides Cryptid and DNA being banned in this deck.

name: Hologram
text: Hologram is probably weakest when paired with strategies that prioritize Straights and Straight Flushes, because it is harder to gain cards into runs than it is to gain cards into sets.

name: Hologram
text: Erosion has anti-synergy as it gives mult for having a small deck.

name: Hologram
text: Since one of the primary ways to scale Hologram is with the use of Booster Packs, Red Card can be hard to use alongside Hologram.

name: Ice Cream
text: Plasma Deck benefits the most from Ice Cream, as the large amount of chips, when balanced, greatly boost score for the played hand.

name: Ice Cream
text: It's recommended to play strong, 5-cards hand to score large with Ice Cream. If you can beat blinds with fewer hands, then Ice Cream will last longer. However, when paired with other jokers, Ice Cream can be part of a strategy that makes low-chip hands, like High Card or Pair, high scoring.

name: Ice Cream
text: Ice Cream can synergize with the following jokers:

name: Ice Cream
text: Throwback: Ice Cream melts with every hand played, and Throwback wants to skip blinds.

name: Ice Cream
text: As a chips-type Joker, Ice Cream pairs well with any additive mult or multiplicative mult Jokers.

name: Ice Cream
text: If a hand that is not allowed is played during The Psychic, The Mouth or The Eye, Ice Cream will still lose 5 Chips.

name: Ice Cream
text: Ice Cream is one of the best early-game Jokers. Most chips-type Jokers have significant tradeoffs, or require more hands to boost properly, which makes them unsuitable for the early-game.

name: Ice Cream
text: Without any other jokers, enhanced cards, or leveled hand types, the best hand is a Royal Flush, worth 100 Chips, plus 50 Chips for the cards, and 8 Mult. A fully topped ice cream is worth the equivalent of x1.66 Mult for this hand. For a more typical good hand (like a KKKQQ full house), worth 40 Chips, plus 50 Chips for the cards, and 4 Mult, a fully topped ice cream is worth the equivalent of x2.2 Mult! There are no jokers in the deck this effective for a starting build.

name: Ice Cream
text: As Ice Cream melts, it becomes significantly less valuable. If you depend on Ice Cream, keep an eye out for its replacement. Try not to add editions to it, as you'll lose them when it melts away.

name: Ice Cream
text: In the early game, when paired a strong global + Mult joker, like Mystic Summit or Gros Michel, Ice Cream can allow otherwise low-value hands to score big, letting you beat blinds without using hands or discards, thereby racking up an early economy. Once you get past Ante 2 or 3, Ice Cream loses its relative effectiveness, compared to other build strategies.
